Myanmar FoodBev is an annual trade fair held in the heart of Yangon and has established itself as the leading platform for Myanmar’s food and beverage industry. The name "FoodBev" succinctly stands for Food & Beverage and clearly reflects the event’s focus: exploring the latest developments, innovations, and driving forces in the world of food and drink. The event is organized by Index Creative Village PCL, a renowned company recognized throughout Southeast Asia for delivering high-quality professional trade shows. Once a year, the Myanmar FoodBev becomes a central meeting point for industry professionals from Myanmar and the ASEAN region who come to gain insights into trends, technologies, and market opportunities across the sector. The exhibition offers a targeted overview of the entire value chain – from raw materials, ingredients, and additives to processed foods and beverages, as well as cutting-edge solutions for processing, packaging, and distribution. Myanmar FoodBev connects players from manufacturing, supply, and trade with key service providers – including professionals from the hospitality and catering industries, bakeries, airlines, cruise lines, railway companies, and resorts. The fair is complemented by a strong supporting program featuring conferences and expert-led seminars, where leading specialists share knowledge and discuss the opportunities and challenges in one of Asia’s most dynamic growth markets. The event reflects both economic momentum and cultural diversity, highlighting Myanmar’s ambition to position itself as a serious contender in the global food and beverage landscape. Held alongside Myanmar Retail Sourcing Expo, the fair also fosters additional synergies between commerce and industry.

The ISM Middle East is the leading trade fair for confectionery and snacks in the MENA region and is held annually at the prestigious Dubai World Trade Centre. Organized by Koelnmesse International in cooperation with Dubai World Trade Centre L.L.C., the fair specifically focuses on the latest trends and innovations in the confectionery sector. The abbreviation ISM stands for "International Sweets Fair", highlighting the global focus of the event on sweet treats and snack products. It attracts industry experts from around the world, including manufacturers, distributors, and buyers, who are all in search of new products and services. The range of goods includes a variety of items such as chocolate products, fine baked goods, traditional and innovative confectioneries, snacks, biscuits, cakes, ice cream, desserts, and date palm products. A highlight of ISM Middle East are the ISM Middle East Awards, which recognize outstanding innovations and achievements in the industry. The "ISM Middle East Expert Stage" provides a forum for discussions on current topics such as the impact of artificial intelligence and mindful snacking, making the fair a hub for future-oriented discussions. The fair also strengthens Dubai's position as a commercial hub in the Middle East and establishes the city as a nexus for the confectionery and snack industry in the region. The easy accessibility of the Dubai World Trade Centre makes it convenient for participants and visitors to attend the fair. As part of a series of ISM fairs worldwide, ISM Middle East underscores its significance in a global event series. In conclusion, ISM Middle East is more than just a fair; it is a central meeting point for professionals from the confectionery and snack industry, where they can network, learn, and grow while enjoying the dynamic atmosphere of Dubai.

개최장소(베뉴): Shanghai New International Expo Center - SNIEC
축제소개: The FHC China - Food & Hospitality China is an international trade fair for food and beverages, held annually in November in Shanghai, one of the world's most dynamic culinary capitals. Since its inception, it has evolved into an indispensable event for the food and hospitality industry in Asia and beyond. This prestigious event is jointly organized by the Shanghai Sinoexpo Informa Markets International Exhibition Co., Ltd. and the Shanghai Cuisine Association, both of which are stakeholders with significant influence and expertise in the industry. Each year, FHC China showcases an impressive array of products and services that cover the entire supply chain of the food industry. Core topics of the fair include meat and dairy products, confectionery and chocolate, spices and oils, coffee and tea, as well as areas for bakeries and light meals. In addition, the fair provides a comprehensive overview of food processing and packaging and presents innovations in the field of prefabricated tableware and central kitchens. A distinctive feature of FHC China is its commitment to education and advancement within the industry. The fair offers a comprehensive series of seminars and workshops on current trends and developments in various segments, including food production, the wine industry, and marketing. The fair takes place at the Shanghai New International Expo Centre (SNIEC), one of China's leading exhibition centers, which, with its modern facilities and extensive infrastructure, is ideal for an event of this magnitude. SNIEC is known for its easily accessible location and the ability to host a variety of events, from international exhibitions to private corporate events. Visiting FHC China offers not just the opportunity to discover new products and place orders, but also an environment for networking and building business relationships, crucial for future success in the fast-paced world of gastronomy and hospitality. With its wide range of exhibitors, access to industry-leading information, and its position as a gateway to Asia's emerging markets, FHC China is an indispensable date in the food and beverage industry's calendar.

The Bulpek in Sofia is a trade fair that has established itself as one of the most important events in the bakery, confectionery, and food industry in Bulgaria. It takes place annually and is organized by the National Association of Bakers and Confectioners in close cooperation with the Inter Expo Center. At the heart of the Bulpek fair is the presentation of an extensive range of products and services covering all segments of the baking industry. These include bread and baked goods, confectionery, raw materials and additives, specialized machinery and technologies, comprehensive solutions for producing a wide array of items, from pastries to chocolate products, as well as facilities for ice cream production. The fair also highlights areas such as refrigeration equipment, laboratory equipment, packaging solutions, delivery services, specialized vehicles, and professional literature. One of the main objectives of Bulpek is to introduce participants to the latest trends and innovations in the industry. This is achieved through an impressive exhibition of packaging machines, modern baking technologies, the latest ingredients and raw materials, and finished bakery and confectionery products. The fair serves as a platform for national and international professionals to exchange knowledge, network, and promote potential business relationships. Bulpek is not just a showcase for products and services, but also stands out for its extensive program of expert lectures, presentations, and live demonstrations. These interactive elements provide visitors with valuable insights into best practices, quality standards, and future market opportunities. The event is hosted at the Inter Expo Center (IEC) in Sofia, a leading exhibition center that provides a suitable setting for an event of this magnitude with its modern facilities and services. The IEC is known for its accessible location and high-quality amenities, allowing exhibitors and visitors to effectively showcase products and deepen business relationships in a professional environment. In summary, Bulpek is an indispensable event for professionals in the bakery and confectionery industry and related sectors. It offers a holistic overview of the Bulgarian market and serves as a springboard for new business opportunities, partnerships, and the expansion of professional networks on both a national and international level.

The " JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR" (JFEF) is an annual trade fair for importers, wholesalers and buyers of Japanese food and beverages and held at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, near Tokyo. It serves as a central hub for the export of Japanese food and beverages. The event is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a leader in the organization of international large-scale events. The fair's goal is to bridge Japanese exporters and global markets. The fair's offerings include a wide range of products: fresh agricultural produce, seafood, meat products, processed foods, and Japanese tea varieties such as green tea, Matcha, Sencha, and Genmaicha. Additionally, Japanese beverages like sake and beer, non-alcoholic options, confectioneries, snacks, health-oriented foods, sustainable and allergen-free products, as well as traditional spices and sauces are highlighted. The fair also showcases the latest trends in kitchen appliances and tableware. In addition to product presentations, the JFEF provides comprehensive services in logistics and transportation, facilitating international trade. It attracts numerous visitors, including foreign importers, traders, international trade associations, government institutions, and media representatives. Primary visitors also include buyers from retail, department stores, hotels, restaurants, and the food processing industry. A distinctive feature of the fair is its highlights, such as tastings, sushi-making workshops, and business matchmaking activities. These offerings enrich the fair with a vibrant experience that not only promotes business exchange but also provides deep cultural insights and strengthens the relationship between Japanese culture and global markets. The JFEF is part of a series of fairs and is held in one of Japan's leading exhibition halls. Its modern infrastructure and accessibility, combined with its proximity to Tokyo, provide an attractive incentive for international visitors who seek not only business opportunities but also cultural enrichment. In summary, the JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR is an essential platform for stakeholders in the international food trade to explore the diversity and quality of Japanese products and to establish direct contacts with leading manufacturers and exporters.

The "JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR" (JFEF) is an annual trade fair for importers, wholesalers and buyers of Japanese food and beverages, held at the Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo. It has established itself as a central hub for exporting Japanese food and beverages. The event is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a leader in organizing large international events, with the aim of connecting Japanese exporters to global markets. The fair offers a wide range of products including fresh agricultural produce, seafood, meat products, processed foods, and a variety of Japanese teas such as green tea, matcha, sencha, and genmaicha. Additionally, Japanese beverages like sake and beer, non-alcoholic alternatives, confections, snacks, and health-oriented foods are presented. Sustainable and allergen-free products, as well as traditional spices and sauces, are also highlighted. The fair additionally showcases the latest trends in kitchen appliances and tableware. Besides product presentations, the JFEF provides comprehensive logistics and transportation services to facilitate international trade. It attracts a diverse group of visitors including foreign importers, traders, international trade associations, government institutions, and media representatives. The main attendees include buyers from retail, department stores, hotels, restaurants, and the food processing industry. A distinctive feature of the fair are its highlights such as tastings, sushi-making workshops, and business matchmaking activities, which not only promote business exchange but also offer deep cultural insights and strengthen the relationship between Japanese culture and global markets. The JFEF is part of a series of fairs and takes place in one of Japan's leading exhibition halls. Thanks to its modern infrastructure and convenient location in the heart of Tokyo, Tokyo Big Sight offers an attractive incentive for international visitors seeking not only business opportunities but also cultural enrichment. In summary, the JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR at Tokyo Big Sight serves as an essential platform for stakeholders in international food trade to explore the diversity and quality of Japanese products and to establish direct contacts with leading manufacturers and exporters.

개최장소(베뉴): Israel Trade Fairs & Convention Center - Expo Tel Aviv
축제소개: The "BAKE & CAKE" is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a central platform for the bakery and confectionery industry. The name of the fair already hints at its focus: "BAKE" stands for bakery products, and "CAKE" for confectionery items. It takes place at the Israel Trade Fairs & Convention Center (Expo Tel Aviv) in Tel Aviv – a city known for its dynamic food and cultural scene, lending the fair a special relevance. It is organized by Stier Group Ltd., one of the leading companies in the trade fair and event industry. The "BAKE & CAKE" covers a wide range of topics: from machinery, equipment, and technologies for the bakery and confectionery industries to ingredients, tools, and packaging products. A particular focus is placed on areas such as frozen and deep-frozen bakery goods as well as innovative solutions for professional bakeries and confectioneries. The range of exhibitors spans from manufacturers and importers to providers of specialized services, encompassing sectors such as bakery production, chocolate making, and specialized food technologies. The fair attracts a broad spectrum of professional visitors, including bakeries and confectioneries, confectioners, chocolate makers, boutique bread bakers, chefs, gastronomes, and decision-makers from the food and beverage management. A special highlight is the various conferences and seminars addressing important industry topics. These include the gastronomy conference of the food and retail sector and the annual meeting of the event and venue industry, offering a platform for knowledge exchange and networking. Thus, the "BAKE & CAKE" represents a significant opportunity for international and local actors to network, discover the latest trends, and deepen business relationships. Finally, the Israel Trade Fairs & Convention Center in Tel Aviv, as the venue for the fair, is particularly noteworthy. This modern exhibition center is not only easily accessible but also offers an ideal infrastructure for exhibitors and visitors from all over the world. In this vibrant city, a culinary and cultural melting pot, the "BAKE & CAKE" reflects the innovation and diversity of the global bakery and confectionery industry.

The GLOBAL FOOD Expo is an internationally oriented trade fair with a strong focus on the future. It has established itself as a central meeting point for industry professionals from all sectors of the food industry. The name “GLOBAL FOOD Expo” reflects not only the international significance of the event but also its broad emphasis on globalization, innovation in the food sector, and international networking. The trade fair once again opens its doors at the modern Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn, near Warsaw – the largest exhibition center in Central and Eastern Europe. The organizer is Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o.o., renowned for professionally hosting leading international trade fairs. The GLOBAL FOOD Expo takes place annually. The event focuses on current developments in food production, processing, and distribution. It is specifically aimed at decision-makers, developers, technologists, traders, and logistics experts. Visitors can expect to see innovative technologies, sustainable packaging solutions, modern refrigeration and catering equipment, as well as efficient logistics systems. Special emphasis is placed on certification and quality standards such as HACCP, ISO, and organic labels, which are becoming increasingly important in global competition. A central feature of the trade fair is the accompanying Global Food Forum . This platform brings together international experts to discuss future-oriented topics such as food security, digital transformation in the food industry, and climate-friendly production processes. The event thrives on dynamic exchange – between start-ups and established companies, technicians and strategists, buyers and producers. Exhibitors represent a wide range of industries, including food processing machinery, packaging technology, refrigeration and storage systems, transport, certification services, wholesale, and foodservice supply. The primary target audience consists of professionals in food processing, trade, logistics, gastronomy, and quality management. The Ptak Warsaw Expo is exceptionally well connected. Located just a few kilometers from Warsaw city center and Chopin Airport, it offers spacious exhibition halls, modern infrastructure, and excellent accessibility for international visitors. For anyone looking to help shape the trends of tomorrow, the GLOBAL FOOD Expo provides the ideal platform.

Salon du Chocolat in Toronto is Canada’s leading exhibition dedicated to chocolate, cocoa, pâtisserie and confectionery. Bringing together indulgence, craftsmanship, innovation and international industry expertise under one roof, it offers far more than a traditional chocolate show. As part of the globally renowned Salon du Chocolat series, the event serves as an international platform for the entire cocoa and chocolate value chain, from cocoa-growing regions and bean production to the latest creations of leading chocolatiers, pastry chefs and dessert specialists. The event takes place at the Toronto Congress Centre, one of Canada’s largest and most modern exhibition and convention venues. It is organised by Comexposium, a France-based organiser and one of the world’s leading exhibition groups. Comexposium delivers numerous international trade and consumer events across a wide range of industries and is particularly recognised for its high-quality B2B and consumer exhibitions. At the heart of Salon du Chocolat Toronto are premium chocolates, high-quality cocoa products, bean-to-bar concepts, artisanal production methods, and the increasingly important topics of cocoa origin and sustainability. More than 120 exhibitors showcase chocolate specialities, pralines, cocoa products, desserts, baked goods, ice cream and confectionery creations, as well as innovative ingredients and technologies for the chocolate and pastry sectors. The exhibition is further complemented by services relating to production, packaging, distribution, foodservice, training and business consultancy. The event plays an important role within Canada and particularly within the Greater Toronto area. As the country’s largest city and a major international business and cultural hub, Toronto provides an ideal setting for dialogue between North American and global market participants. The exhibition brings together producers from leading cocoa-growing countries with Canadian and international chocolate manufacturers, distributors, buyers and retailers, helping to strengthen global industry connections. One of the event’s best-known attractions is the spectacular Chocolate Fashion Show, the signature feature of the Salon du Chocolat brand. Designers and chocolatiers collaborate to create extraordinary fashion pieces made wholly or partly from chocolate. The programme also includes tastings, live demonstrations by renowned pastry chefs and chocolatiers, interactive workshops, expert presentations and immersive experiences exploring cocoa and chocolate production. Visitors also gain exclusive insights into the latest trends shaping the international worlds of desserts and chocolate artistry. Exhibitors primarily represent the chocolate manufacturing, cocoa production, pâtisserie, confectionery, bakery, confectionery manufacturing, hospitality, food processing, packaging technology and retail sectors. Participants range from global brands and specialist artisan producers to bean-to-bar makers, suppliers and innovative start-ups. The visitor profile is equally diverse. Alongside chocolate enthusiasts and consumers, the exhibition attracts professionals from pâtisserie, confectionery, hospitality, hotel management, retail, import and export, food manufacturing, wholesale distribution, procurement and product development. This successful combination of consumer appeal and professional networking makes the event both a public exhibition and a valuable industry platform. Salon du Chocolat Toronto forms part of an international exhibition series staged in major cities around the world. In addition to Toronto, editions are held in destinations including Paris, New York, London, Brussels, Dubai and Tokyo. As a result, the event benefits from the strength of a globally recognised brand and an extensive network within the international chocolate and cocoa industry. With its unique blend of indulgence, expertise, innovation and entertainment, Salon du Chocolat Toronto ranks among the most important events in the North American chocolate and pastry sectors. The Toronto Congress Centre provides an outstanding venue, offering modern infrastructure, expansive exhibition space and a convenient location close to Toronto Pearson International Airport. Excellent road links, public transport connections and international air access ensure that the venue is easily accessible for both domestic and international visitors.

Established in 1991, the Peterfood Trade Fair is an international exposition for food and food technology and is among the most significant culinary events in St. Petersburg. The name "Peterfood" is a combination of "Peter", referring to the city of St. Petersburg, and "food". The fair takes place annually at the prestigious ExpoForum Convention & Exhibition Centre in St. Petersburg and is organized by the Convention & Exhibition Company Imperia-Forum Ltd. The fair showcases a wide range of products and services, including confectionery and baked goods, meat and dairy products, snacks, frozen foods, beverages, tea, coffee, as well as ecological and bio-based products. Areas such as food technology, equipment, and glass packaging are also highlighted. Exhibitors from food manufacturing, beverage production, and food technology present themselves to a diverse audience that includes both professionals and amateur cooks. The Peterfood Trade Fair serves not only as a showcase for food and technologies but also as a platform for initiating business connections. Manufacturers have the opportunity to negotiate product deliveries to regional and national retail chains, marketplaces, and restaurants, making the fair a central meeting point for the food industry in Russia. The event also offers a series of seminars, workshops, and conferences where industry experts share their knowledge and experiences. Highlights include award ceremonies for industry competitions such as "Innovative Product", "Our Brand", "Choice of Chains", and the "Peterfood Technology Award". Exhibitors represent various sectors of the food industry and gastronomy. The main visitor groups come from retail, gastronomy, and food production. The ExpoForum Convention & Exhibition Centre in St. Petersburg, easily accessible via various modes of transportation, provides impressive infrastructure for exhibitors and visitors, along with the opportunity to explore the cultural attractions of the city of St. Petersburg. In conclusion, the Peterfood Trade Fair is an indispensable event for anyone working in the food and technology sectors, looking to stay informed about current trends and establish new business contacts. The impressive ExpoForum and the picturesque city of St. Petersburg make participation in the fair an unforgettable experience.

The FOOD & LIFE event in Munich is a prestigious consumer and sales fair dedicated entirely to the themes of food, drink, and enjoyment. Established in 2004, the fair has been organized by GHM Gesellschaft für Handwerksmessen mbH and, since the spring of 2023, takes place twice a year. It has established itself as Germany's largest meeting point for culinary excellence, attracting visitors interested in high-quality, artisanal delicacies. The fair offers an impressive variety of products and services. Ranging from small manufacturers with regional specialties to producers of sustainable organic products, the selection is diverse. It includes spreads, baked and confectionery goods, fine and health foods, fish, meat and sausages, beverages and spirits, spices, herbs, vinegar, oil, coffee, tea, dairy products, eggs, fruits, and vegetables. This culinary abundance makes the fair a paradise for gourmets and lovers of good taste. A distinctive feature of FOOD & LIFE is the presentation by passionate distillers, brewers, coffee roasters, chocolatiers, and butchers, who showcase their products and their production processes. Celebrity chefs demonstrate their skills on live stages, making the fair an interactive and educational experience. The venue, Messe München, provides an ideal platform for this event. With its modern infrastructure and accessibility, it is a suitable setting for showcasing the diverse culinary world.

The Ethno Food & Drink Fair is an annual event first held in 2006. It takes place at the Belgrade Fair in Belgrade, Serbia, and is renowned for showcasing and promoting ethnic foods and beverages. The name of the fair reflects its focus on traditional, ethnic products. The fair is organized by Beogradski sajam, a prominent exhibition company. It annually provides a platform for manufacturers and suppliers of foods and beverages made using traditional recipes. Moreover, the main themes of the fair cover a wide range of products and services, including special equipment and packaging for these items. The Ethno Food & Drink Fair holds special significance for Belgrade and Serbia as it highlights traditional products while offering insights into the culinary culture and heritage of the region. It plays a key role in branding and marketing local products and contributes to the promotion of tourism. One of the highlights of the fair is the "Ethno Food & Drinks – Brand of Serbia" award. This accolade is presented by a panel of expert judges who evaluate the quality of the exhibited goods. Additionally, the Food & Drink Fair fosters knowledge exchange and the further education of participants. In the showcase area of the event, whether in the Ethno Court or at the exhibitors' stands, region-specific and sometimes forgotten dishes are presented and tasted, helping to acquaint visitors with the flavors and customs of various eras and regions. Exhibitors come from various sectors, including food production, gastronomy, and equipment manufacturing. The main visitors include shops, restaurants, hotels, large retail chains, and individuals interested in traditional products. The Belgrade Fair is a centrally located and easily accessible venue in Belgrade, offering an ideal platform for the presentation and promotion of traditional products and services.

Food Africa is the premier trade exhibition for the food and beverage industry across the African continent and the Middle East. Held annually at the Egypt International Exhibition Center (EIEC) in Cairo, the event has established itself over the past decade as an essential platform for international trade. It offers manufacturers, exporters, buyers, and decision-makers from around the globe direct access to the region’s fast-growing markets. Organized by IFP Egypt – an experienced trade fair organizer specializing in the Middle East and Africa – Food Africa serves not only as a marketplace but also as a strategic hub for partnerships, product innovation, and market insights. The exhibition focuses on the entire value chain of the food industry. Its product range is extensive, covering everything from fresh produce such as fruits, vegetables, meat, and poultry to dairy products, frozen foods, and baked goods. It also showcases specialties like dates, halal products, gluten-free items, ready-to-eat meals, and international delicacies. Beverages such as juices, water, coffee, tea, and energy drinks are also well represented, along with sweets, spices, oils, and canned goods. In addition, the event features technological services, transport and logistics solutions, as well as organic, dietary, and ethically certified food products. Choosing Cairo as the host city provides a distinct strategic advantage: Egypt is considered a central trade hub in Africa and, due to its geographic location at the crossroads of three continents, offers access to a wide range of markets. The EIEC impresses with its modern infrastructure and excellent connectivity to Cairo International Airport and the city’s transportation network. A standout feature of Food Africa is its international B2B programs, live cooking shows, guided buyer tours, and industry-specific forums that enrich the event every year with a dynamic supporting program. Exhibitors come from diverse sectors, including agriculture, food processing, packaging, retail and wholesale, gastronomy, and franchising. Key visitors include importers, retailers, supermarket chains, distributors, wholesalers, and HoReCa professionals actively seeking new business opportunities. Thanks to its unique blend of regional focus, global reach, and deep market knowledge, Food Africa offers an ideal platform to position brands, set trends, and tap into new markets—right in the heart of one of Africa’s most vital economic zones. The modern EIEC venue provides the perfect setting for effective networking, impactful presentations, and high-level business deals.

The Baker Technology Fair (BTF) is a specialized business-to-business trade show dedicated to India’s dynamic and fast-growing bakery, confectionery, and snack industry. Known by its acronym “BTF,” the event serves as an exclusive industry forum, bringing together cutting-edge solutions and forward-looking technologies in the realm of baked goods and sweet treats. The Baker Technology Fair takes place twice a year, alternating between the cities of Codissa and Bangalore, and brings together India's experts, manufacturers, suppliers and service providers, offering a comprehensive overview of current market trends, product innovations and sustainable production processes. The event is organized by Synergy Exposures & Events India Pvt. Ltd. , an experienced trade fair organizer focused on industry-specific formats with strong market and sector relevance. Over the years, BTF has established itself as a key platform for the Indian bakery and confectionery sector. It promotes professional exchange, facilitates business networking, and supports innovation processes. Thematically, the fair covers a broad spectrum—from modern baking technology, automation, and digital process control to eco-friendly packaging solutions, sustainable raw materials, food-safe production, and hands-on professional development. Developments in both artisanal and industrial sectors, as well as the influence of Industry 4.0, are also specifically addressed. Particular attention is given to the integrated thematic areas of "Innovative Ingredients" and "Food Packaging," which explore new ingredient concepts and packaging trends—both critical factors for maintaining competitiveness in the industry. The fair is further enriched by the “Bakers Knowledge Sharing Forum,” which features expert talks, panel discussions, and workshops aimed at facilitating targeted knowledge transfer and providing practical insights for professionals and decision-makers. The range of exhibitors spans all key segments of the industry: from bakery equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and raw material suppliers to packaging innovators and hygiene and quality assurance solution providers. Visitors mainly include representatives from bakeries, the broader food industry, gastronomy businesses, and supply chains—decision-makers in search of concrete solutions, partnerships, and new expertise. Each event venue is selected for its modern infrastructure, strong transport connectivity, and location in economically vibrant metropolitan regions. With access to airports, expressways, and urban transit networks, the fair is easily accessible both nationally and internationally. With its clear professional focus, high level of innovation, and strategic relevance, the Baker Technology Fair has become an essential flagship event for all those committed to actively shaping the future of India’s bakery and confectionery industry.

The SIGEP fair, whose name stands for "Salone Internazionale Gelateria, Pasticceria e Panificazione Artigianali" and translates to “International Fair for Artisanal Ice Cream, Pastry, and Bakery,” takes place annually in Rimini, Italy. It is organized by the Italian Exhibition Group (IEG) and is considered one of the most important international trade fairs in the fields of artisanal ice cream, pastry, bakery, chocolate, and coffee. The fair showcases a wide range of products and services, including raw materials, ingredients, frozen products, machinery, furniture and equipment, packaging, as well as facilities and accessories for the production of confectionery, pastries, ice cream, and coffee. The main themes of the fair – innovation, quality, sustainability, and international trends – are reflected in all exhibition areas, from gelato and bakery to pastry, coffee, and chocolate. A distinctive feature of SIGEP is its significance for Rimini and Italy, as it serves as a meeting point for industry experts from around the world and highlights Italian excellence in these crafts. The fair offers a variety of live demonstrations, competitions, expert talks, and networking events, making it a dynamic and interactive event. Exhibitors from various sectors, including food production, gastronomy, and food service, present their products and services here. The main visitors are professionals from these areas, looking for the latest trends, technologies, and business opportunities. SIGEP is part of a series of international fairs that take place in various locations, each with its own focus and character. The Rimini Fiera exhibition center, the venue for SIGEP, is known for its modern infrastructure and accessibility. It provides an ideal platform for exchange between exhibitors and visitors. Located in Rimini, a city with a rich cultural history and picturesque beaches, it adds to the fair's attractiveness and makes it an unforgettable experience for participants from all over the world.

NEW LABEL POLAND is Poland’s leading industry event, dedicated with precision and innovative drive to private labels, modern consumer goods trends, and technological solutions. The name “NEW LABEL” symbolizes the fair’s core mission: a leap into new brand worlds – the development of future-oriented products and the creation of unique customer experiences through private labels, packaging technology, and product design. The event serves not only as a marketplace but also as a strategic forum actively shaping the transformation of the consumer goods industry. The venue is the prestigious PTAK Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn – Poland’s largest and most modern exhibition center, located just a few kilometers from Warsaw. The event is organized by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o. o. , renowned for high-quality trade fairs with international appeal and outstanding logistical infrastructure. At the heart of NEW LABEL POLAND are the latest developments and trends in the sectors of fresh products, frozen foods, shelf-stable groceries, confectionery, baked goods, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Also strongly represented are health and functional foods, personal care and cosmetic products, household chemicals, baby and child care items, pet supplies, as well as pioneering innovations in packaging, labeling, and private label technologies. The fair is not only a comprehensive product platform but also a showcase for technological solutions – from smart packaging and automation to digital private label management. NEW LABEL POLAND brings together manufacturers, retail chains, suppliers, and decision-makers from across Europe – spanning the food and beverage industry, drugstore and cosmetics sector, and wholesale and retail trade. Special focus is placed on professional visitors from the private label segment, including product developers, buyers, packaging specialists, and retail brand strategists. As such, the fair functions as a highly specialized, internationally oriented B2B networking event. A true highlight is the presentation of innovative products, where outstanding private label developments and breakthrough technologies are recognized and awarded. With its strong focus on the Central European market and deliberate positioning in economically dynamic Poland, the fair also acts as a bridge between Western and Eastern Europe. It highlights Poland’s strategic role in the production, development, and trade of consumer goods. The PTAK Warsaw Expo is conveniently located near the capital city of Warsaw and is easily accessible via the S8 expressway or by shuttle service from Chopin Airport and the city center. With state-of-the-art infrastructure, expansive exhibition halls, and comprehensive business facilities, the venue offers ideal conditions for both exhibitors and visitors.

The ISM Manufacturing , founded in 2006 and held under the name "ProSweets Cologne" until 2026, is an international trade fair that focuses specifically on the comprehensive range of suppliers to the confectionery and snack industry . This fair takes place annually in Cologne and runs concurrently with the ISM, the world's largest trade fair for confectionery and snacks. An interesting detail is that ISM Manufacturing takes a break in the years when Interpack occurs, another significant trade fair for packaging and process technology. Organized by Koelnmesse GmbH, the fair continually evolves to match the latest trends and demands of the industry. ISM Manufacturing covers a wide range of topics, including raw materials and ingredients for confectionery production, packaging materials and technologies, manufacturing machinery and equipment, and crucial aspects like refrigeration and climate technology, food safety, and quality management. A special highlight of the fair is the Robotics-Pack-Line, a demonstration showcasing the use of robotics and automation technologies in a fully automated snack packaging line. These innovations highlight the industry's move towards greater efficiency and precision. ISM Manufacturing is not just a platform for product and service presentation but also a hub for exchange and networking among professionals worldwide. It offers service providers, organizations, and publishers the opportunity to showcase themselves and discuss the latest findings and technologies. The venue, Köln Messe, is a modern and accessible exhibition center, ideally suited for showcasing such an extensive and diverse industry. ISM Manufacturing has thus established itself as a central meeting point for professionals in the confectionery industry, offering a unique opportunity to stay informed about the latest innovations and trends.

Vitafoods India is a specialized trade fair accompanied by a conference, dedicated to the rapidly growing industry of dietary supplements, functional foods, and health-focused nutrition. Since its launch in 2023, it has established itself as a key industry platform in India. The event is held annually at the Jio World Convention Centre (JWCC) in Mumbai – one of Asia’s most advanced venues, offering excellent infrastructure and direct connections to hotels, the international airport, and the city center. Vitafoods India is organized by Informa PLC, a global leader in trade exhibitions, conferences, and industry intelligence, headquartered in London. As part of the international Vitafoods event series, it plays a strategically important role within the global health and nutrition network. The focus of the exhibition is on science-backed innovations and current market trends across the entire value chain of the nutraceutical and functional food industry. Exhibitors showcase their latest developments in raw materials, ingredients, dietary supplements, functional foods and beverages, botanical extracts, packaging, processing technologies, laboratory analytics, as well as research and development. A highlight of the event is the Innovation Zone, where groundbreaking product innovations and technological advancements are unveiled for the first time. The event attracts industry professionals from across India and increasingly from international markets – including manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, scientists, product developers, marketing specialists, regulatory experts, and decision-makers from the fields of nutrition, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, food technology, and healthcare. The accompanying conference provides in-depth insights into regulatory developments, scientific research, market analysis, and supply chain solutions. It promotes knowledge sharing and strengthens the industry’s capacity for innovation. India is considered one of the fastest-growing markets in the field of health-focused nutrition. A strong demand for natural products, Ayurvedic formulations, and modern health solutions is driving this trend. Vitafoods India responds to these developments by offering a platform that connects local market potential with global innovation. The exhibition experience is further enhanced by networking events, interactive formats, and special features such as product showcases and expert panels – offering ideal opportunities for building business relationships and staying attuned to industry developments. The Jio World Convention Centre, located in the central Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), reflects the high standards of the event. It is easily accessible – whether by car, train, or from the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, which is just around 20 minutes away.

Expo Sweet is the specialized trade fair for the confectionery and ice cream industry in Poland, held annually at the EXPO XXI convention center in Warsaw. As a central hub for professionals from the confectionery, ice cream, and bakery sectors, it provides a platform for showcasing innovations, new technologies, and trends that drive these industries forward. The fair is distinguished by its wide range of exhibition topics, from innovative ice cream flavors and advanced production methods to the latest bakery technologies and trends in confectionery production. Expo Sweet offers a unique insight into current and future market developments and presents innovative products and services that attract visitors from around the world. Another highlight is the numerous competitions, including the Polish championships in dessert preparation, the Polish championships for confectionery students, and the open competition for sugar decorations. These competitions provide a stage for creativity and expertise, attracting both talented newcomers and established professionals. Expo Sweet also contributes to the promotion of the local economy and culture in Warsaw by bringing a large number of exhibitors and visitors to the city, thereby invigorating local tourism and business activities. The fair is organized by Expo Sweet EZIG, which is committed to offering an even more extensive and detailed event each year. The modern and accessible EXPO XXI convention center provides ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors to discover new business opportunities and expand networks. In summary, Expo Sweet is not just a trade fair, but an annual institution that offers crucial insights and excellent networking opportunities for professionals in the confectionery, ice cream, and bakery industries. With its excellent infrastructure and accessibility, the EXPO XXI convention center underscores Warsaw's importance as a central trading hub in Poland and Europe.

SANA Food , a major trade fair for the food industry, was established in 1988 and takes place annually at the prestigious BolognaFiere exhibition center in Bologna. Its central location in one of Italy’s most diverse culinary cities provides easy access for both locals and international visitors, blending tradition with modern hospitality. The fair is dedicated to sustainable and healthy food options, perfectly meeting the consumers' demand for nutritious and innovative products. The selection includes vegan, vegetarian, and plant-based products, specialties for specific dietary needs, and certified organic products, which have been the cornerstone of the fair for over three decades. SANA Food connects professionals from the hospitality, retail, and distribution sectors, creating a platform for the exchange of ideas and business opportunities. The fair showcases a wide array of innovations, from new recipes to advanced packaging solutions, all aimed at making the food industry more sustainable. Another highlight is the concurrent Slow Wine Fair, which enriches the offering with sustainably produced, high-quality wines. Additionally, the fair hosts a series of events, including the SANA Novità, a project aiming to showcase innovations and new developments in the agrifood sector, Rivoluzione Bio, the General Assembly of Organic Farming , where leading players in the organic market discuss key industry issues,and a wide range of conferences. The organizer, BolognaFiere S.p.A., ensures that a comprehensive program is offered each year, not only providing information but also practical insights into the latest culinary techniques. This is achieved through cooking shows and masterclasses led by renowned chefs and experts. Thanks to its central location in Bologna, the fair is easily accessible and surrounded by excellent accommodation and dining options, making it an ideal meeting point for professionals from around the world. Overall, SANA Food offers more than just a trade fair; it is an experience that transports visitors to the future of the food industry, offering unparalleled opportunities for education, innovation, and business development.

GastroPan is a trade fair for the bakery, confectionery, and catering industries. Since its founding in 2009, it has established itself as an important meeting place for professionals, entrepreneurs, and decision-makers. The name is a combination of "Gastro" for "gastronomy" and "Pan" for bread, reflecting the trade fair's focus: food production. The event takes place annually at different locations throughout Romania and is organized by Boro-Info Srl, a company specializing in trade events for the food industry. GastroPan brings together innovation and tradition, addressing current trends such as digitalization and automation to optimize production processes in bakeries and confectioneries. At the same time, it serves as a platform for artisanal craftsmanship, where outstanding professionals showcase their expertise. A particular highlight is the "Bread of the Year" competition, which shines a spotlight on both artisanal and industrial baking excellence. The fair offers a comprehensive range of products and services, including state-of-the-art technologies, equipment, raw materials, and ingredients for the production of bakery and confectionery goods, ice cream, chocolate, and donuts. The gastronomy and HoReCa sectors also benefit from tailored solutions for restaurants, bars, cafés, hotels, guesthouses, and catering businesses. The program is further enriched by IT solutions, consultancy services, and marketing strategies specifically designed for the food industry. In addition to its diverse exhibitor offerings, GastroPan is renowned for its prestigious competitions, where the finest bakery and confectionery products are awarded. These competitions provide professionals with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills and engage with industry peers. Each year, the fair attracts a wide range of bakers, confectioners, restaurateurs, hoteliers, and decision-makers seeking innovative solutions and new business opportunities.

The Food & Hotel Hanoi (FHH) is an international trade fair specialising in food, beverages, hotels, bakeries, restaurants, catering, and related equipment. It takes place at the impressive ICE Hanoi International Exhibition Centre in the heart of Hanoi and attracts numerous visitors from both domestic and international locations. Informa Markets Vietnam, a leading organiser of trade shows and events, is responsible for organising this major event. The FHH focuses on innovative ideas, current trends, and forward-looking technologies. Key themes and highlights include biodegradable products, advanced Industry 4.0 technologies, healthy plant-based alternatives, and innovative solutions for the hospitality industry. The exhibition showcases a wide range of products, including bakery and confectionery items, beverages, food products, barista equipment, halal products, organic and health foods, catering supplies, coffee and tea accessories, fast food, fine food, seafood, meat, poultry, fruits, vegetables, and snacks. The Hospitality Zone features topics such as cleaning and maintenance, security systems, disinfection methods, hospitality information systems, hotel and resort management, bar and restaurant management, smart technology for hotels, tableware, and utensils, among others. In addition to the main programme, various accompanying activities are offered, including wine tastings, industry conferences, and live cooking demonstrations by professional chefs. Notably, the culinary competition "Culinaire Vietnam" and the Pastry Innovation Lab, which offers creative masterclasses and enjoyable hi-tea sessions, are worth mentioning. Exhibitors come from diverse industries, ranging from food producers to hoteliers to technology providers. The primary audience of the trade fair consists of hoteliers, retailers, investors, consultants, and buyers who are seeking the latest trends and solutions in their respective fields. The ICE Hanoi International Exhibition Centre, where the fair takes place, is strategically located in the city centre. With its modern facilities and impressive view of the vibrant metropolis of Hanoi, it makes the exhibition visit an unforgettable experience.

The CAKE & BAKE in Dortmund is fully dedicated to the art of baking and cake decoration. Since its inception in 2018, it has grown into the largest fair of its kind in Germany, attracting enthusiasts from both domestic and international locations. It is hosted by Messe Dortmund GmbH at the prestigious Messe Dortmund, known for its excellent facilities and capacity to accommodate large crowds. The fair serves as a platform for ambitious cake bakers and sugar artists to showcase their creations in an annual competition. In addition to this competition, live shows, workshops, demonstrations, and interactive areas provide further highlights. Participants can get inspired by experienced artists, attend "Meet & Greets" with well-known personalities from YouTube and blogs, and discover the latest trends and techniques in baking and decoration. A characteristic of the fair is its international orientation, with exhibitors from various countries offering a wide range of products and services in baking, decoration, patisserie, praline making, and chocolate art. This gives visitors a comprehensive overview of the latest industry innovations and the opportunity to interact directly with manufacturers. A special feature is the synergy with CREATIVA, Europe's largest creative fair, which takes place simultaneously. With a joint ticket, visitors can explore the diversity of the creative and craftsmanship world at both events. In summary, the CAKE & BAKE in Dortmund offers an excellent opportunity to deepen one's passion for baking and cake decoration. With an extensive array of demonstrations, workshops, and exhibitors, it serves as a central meeting point for the baking and cake scene in Germany and beyond.

The "Modern Bakery Moscow" is considered one of the most significant trade fairs in Russia and the CIS states, specializing since its inception in 1995 in the entire spectrum of production and distribution of bakery and confectionery products. It showcases innovative taste trends, ingredients, and techniques of interest to the bakery and confectionery industry. Held annually at the Timiryazev Exhibition Centre in Moscow, the event stands out for its excellent accessibility and modern facilities. The organization is handled by Gefera Media Ltd, a company experienced in managing trade fairs and conferences. The fair covers a wide range of topics: from food processing, various ingredients, raw materials, and additives to shop construction, services, and technologies for the storage and quality control of cereal products. The diversity of products and equipment is particularly impressive, ranging from classic bakery and confectionery machines to specialized equipment for the production of waffles and other specialties. As a crucial interface for the local and international bakery and confectionery industry, "Modern Bakery Moscow" offers a platform for professionals from various related sectors. Here, manufacturers, suppliers, and service providers can discuss the latest trends and technologies and establish business contacts. The fair is characterized by a diverse program, including workshops, master classes, and conferences led by leading experts. Special attention is given to the educational project "Die Schule des Technologen" (The School of the Technologist), specifically aimed at professionals. In summary, the "Modern Bakery Moscow" is indispensable not only for players in the bakery and confectionery industry but also represents a unique opportunity to learn and exchange information about the latest developments and technologies in the heart of Moscow, a city known for its cultural and economic diversity.

The Foodservice & Hospitality Expo, inaugurated in 2018, has established itself as a premier event in Romania's thriving hotel and hospitality industry. Hosted by Marketing Zone SRL, this trade fair is held in Bucharest, specifically in Hala Laminor, a venue renowned for its extensive facilities and exceptional suitability for events and exhibitions. This specialized expo serves as a central platform for professionals in the hospitality sector to explore the latest products, services, and trends in the industry. It stands out for its comprehensive showcase of various hospitality segments, including a wide array of exhibitors presenting a range of products from food and beverages to innovative non-food items, furniture, and technological solutions. The event places a special emphasis on interactivity and firsthand experiences, featuring culinary demonstrations, innovative cooking shows — with a focus on vegan cuisine — and competitions such as the Sushi Cup and thrilling pastry chef challenges. A highlight of the fair is the opportunity for attendees not only to get acquainted with products and services but also to participate in workshops. These sessions address current and significant topics such as food waste, sustainability in catering, functional design in the hotel industry, as well as tax obligations and relevant legislation. Furthermore, the Foodservice & Hospitality Expo acts as a stage for innovation, with the 'Innovation Showcase' inspiring participants through demonstrations of new and pioneering products and services. Beyond the opportunity to deepen business relationships, the Expo offers a unique chance for owners of bars and cafes, chefs, purchasing managers, sommeliers, bartenders, baristas, and consultants to network, learn, and enhance their knowledge and skills through direct interaction and feedback from industry peers. The Foodservice & Hospitality Expo transcends a traditional trade fair; it emphasizes experience, continuing education, and community development, making it an indispensable event in the annual calendar of every professional in Romania's hotel and hospitality industry. It represents not only the diversity and creativity of the sector but also underscores Bucharest's role as an emerging hub for hospitality and tourism in Eastern Europe.

ANUGA Select Brazil is an international trade fair for food and beverages and ranks among the leading business platforms for the food and drink industry in South America. Held annually in April at the Centro de Convenções – Distrito Anhembi in São Paulo, the event brings together producers, importers, distributors, service providers and senior decision-makers with a clear commercial focus. Its purpose is to generate tangible business opportunities, assess market potential and build long-term partnerships. Rather than serving as a straightforward product showcase, the fair positions itself as a strategic hub for innovation, knowledge exchange and international networking. The event is organised by Koelnmesse Organização de Feiras Ltda., the Brazilian subsidiary of Koelnmesse, one of the world’s leading trade fair organisers in the food sector. In addition to its Cologne base, Koelnmesse delivers further ANUGA formats in high-growth markets such as Asia and the Middle East, creating a global network that gives exhibitors direct access to international sales markets. The exhibition presents a broad yet clearly structured product range, including bakery and confectionery, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, dairy products, frozen foods, fine foods, fresh fruit and vegetables, canned and ambient goods, as well as organic and health products. The offering is complemented by retail and point-of-sale solutions, along with services for the grocery retail and foodservice sectors. In doing so, the event covers the entire value chain — from production and processing through to distribution and in-store presentation. A strong emphasis is placed on trends, innovation and market intelligence. ANUGA Select Brazil addresses key issues such as sustainable production, transparent supply chains, new product development, clean-label strategies and shifting consumer preferences. It provides in-depth insights into consumer behaviour across Latin America, set within a broader international context. Specialist forums, conference sessions and networking formats equip industry leaders with strategic input for business development. Exhibitors represent sectors including dairy, organic food production, beverages, foodservice, import and export, as well as related service industries. Trade visitors include professionals from grocery retail and wholesale, hospitality, catering, distribution and food processing. The fair is therefore firmly targeted at a qualified B2B audience with defined purchasing and investment intentions. São Paulo’s role as host city underscores the event’s economic significance. As Brazil’s largest city and principal commercial and financial centre, it serves as a gateway to the Latin American food market. Brazil itself is one of the world’s leading agricultural and food producers. The Centro de Convenções – Distrito Anhembi is among the country’s most established exhibition and convention venues. Modern infrastructure, extensive exhibition space and convenient access to international airports and major transport links ensure straightforward travel for trade visitors from Brazil and abroad. ANUGA Select Brazil combines global exhibition expertise with in-depth regional market knowledge. As part of an international trade fair portfolio, it fosters cross-market synergies and provides companies with a focused platform to showcase innovation, strengthen business relationships and actively shape the future of the food system.

The " Food & Drink OEM Matching Expo ", commonly referred to as the OEM Expo , is an annual trade fair held at Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo. Hosted by Japan Food Journal Co., Ltd., it has established itself as an essential platform for professionals in the food and beverage industry who specialize in the development and production of private labels and OEM products. OEM stands for "Original Equipment Manufacturer", which in this context refers to the production of products under a brand name that does not belong to the manufacturer. Therefore, the fair provides an excellent opportunity to gain deep insights into private label production and establish direct business relationships. The expo covers topics such as processed foods, fresh produce, confections and desserts, spices and sauces, dietary supplements, and beverages, including alcoholic drinks. Additionally, consulting services and analytical devices and systems are presented, enabling participants to explore all aspects from product development to quality control. Exhibitors come from various sectors of food production and related services, ranging from large international corporations to specialized small businesses. The main audience for the fair includes decision-makers in the industry, such as purchasers, product developers, and marketing professionals, making the event a key meeting place for networking and industry insights. Access to the venue, Tokyo Big Sight, is facilitated by its central location and excellent transportation links, including train and bus connections. The modern facilities and impressive architecture of the convention center attract thousands of visitors each year and create an inspiring environment for exhibitions and networking.

Anuga Select Japan is a specialized trade fair for healthy and sustainable food and beverages, held at Tokyo Big Sight, Japan's largest exhibition center. This annual event attracts visitors and exhibitors from around the world who are interested in innovations in the food industry. The name Anuga represents a wide array of products and innovations showcased at the fair. The event aims to meet the growing demand for health-conscious and eco-friendly products, which is especially significant in East Asia where demographic shifts and climate change challenges play a central role. The main themes of the fair include delicacies, meat products, alternative protein sources, and vegan and vegetarian options. A broad range of beverages, from coffee to innovative refreshment drinks, is also presented. These reflect the global trend towards more sustainable and healthier dietary options. Anuga Select Japan serves not only as a platform for knowledge and product exchange but also as a showcase for Japan's unique contributions to food innovation. Exhibitors from various sectors, including food production and technology as well as beverage manufacturing, display their latest developments here. Visitors to the fair are professionals from the food and beverage industry, buyers from large retail chains, and representatives of organizations committed to health and sustainability. They are in search of new products that not only delight the palate but are also beneficial for health and the environment. As part of the globally recognized Anuga fairs, the event offers a comprehensive platform for the global food industry. The strikingly designed Tokyo Big Sight is located on the artificial island of Odaiba in Tokyo Bay and is easily accessible. Anuga Select Japan promises an exciting fair experience with deep insights into the future of the food industry, offering informative and inspiring moments as well as numerous networking opportunities.

Launched in 2022, ISM Japan is the first specialized trade fair for the confectionery and snack industry in East Asia, serving as a significant marketplace for innovations and business developments in this sector. The fair is held annually at Tokyo Big Sight, the largest exhibition and convention center in Tokyo, renowned for its distinctive architecture. It attracts exhibitors and visitors from around the world who are keen to learn about the latest trends and technologies in the industry. Organized by Koelnmesse Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Koelnmesse GmbH based in Cologne, ISM Japan serves as a platform to showcase the latest products in areas such as chocolate, confectionery, fine pastries, savory snacks, bread, cakes, ice cream, and frozen food. Advanced technologies and equipment for the production and packaging of these items are also presented. More than just an exhibition, ISM Japan is a vital meeting point for professionals in the food industry, from producers to suppliers and retailers, making it an indispensable event for those in the sector. A highlight of the fair are the tastings and product demonstrations, which offer participating companies the opportunity to present their innovations to a broad audience and stand out from the competition. Thanks to its close connection to Japan, a country known for its innovative food industry and a commitment to quality and aesthetics, the fair serves not only as a business event but also as a cultural bridge that celebrates the uniqueness and diversity of both Japanese and international confectionery and snack cultures. The central location of Tokyo Big Sight facilitates access for international visitors, making ISM Japan an attractive destination for industry professionals worldwide.

The Dessert Sweets & Bakery Festival (DSB Festival) has established itself as a premier trade fair for the bakery, confectionery, and beverage industries. Held annually at the prestigious Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo, it brings together experts, manufacturers, distributors, and industry professionals from around the world. Organized by Japan Food Journal Co., Ltd., the DSB Festival serves as a central platform for exchanging insights on industry trends, technological innovations, and business collaborations. As part of FABEX, one of Japan’s leading food industry trade fairs, the DSB Festival contributes to the creation of new value in the food business by bridging global culinary cultures with cutting-edge technological advancements. The event focuses on bakery and confectionery products, the beverage industry, food ingredients, and packaging solutions. Exhibitors showcase the latest developments, from high-quality ingredients and innovative baking technologies to creative packaging concepts that are shaping the market. Companies from food production, gastronomy, hospitality, and retail sectors take advantage of the fair to stay informed and expand their professional networks. The DSB Festival stands out for its dynamic atmosphere, featuring live demonstrations, tastings, expert lectures, and seminars. A particular highlight is the renowned Assiette Dessert Contest, a competition for professionals from pastry shops, hotels, and restaurants. Participants create desserts incorporating frozen components into a single, harmoniously composed dish. Besides balance and taste, originality and design play a crucial role in the evaluation process. Deeply rooted in Japanese culture, the DSB Festival reflects Japan’s high standards in food production and its passion for premium baked goods and confectionery. As a vibrant metropolis, Tokyo provides the perfect setting for this trade fair, reinforcing Japan’s role as a leader in food technology and innovation. Tokyo Big Sight, Japan’s largest exhibition center, offers modern infrastructure and excellent accessibility via Haneda International Airport and the public transportation network. Combining expertise, exclusive innovations, and a unique atmosphere, the Dessert Sweets & Bakery Festival is a must-attend event for industry professionals.

The "Market of Good Taste" (Markt des guten Geschmacks) in Stuttgart, a standout fair of the Slow Food movement, takes place annually in the spring. It is dedicated to showcasing and promoting regional specialties that are free from additives. Since its inception, the fair has evolved into a significant meeting point for gourmets and consumers who value quality, taste, and sustainable production. Organized by Messe Stuttgart GmbH, the fair presents an impressive selection of food and beverages from regional producers, with a focus on the quality and taste experience of the products. The event serves not only as a platform for exchange between visitors and exhibitors but also as a place for education and active participation. Visitors have the opportunity to engage directly with the producers, sample their products, and become actively involved in the fair's own cooking workshop. Under guidance, they can prepare their own dishes and then enjoy them in a convivial round. In addition to food and beverages, the fair's offerings also include handmade kitchen furniture and utensils, as well as specialist books on topics related to food and drink. An extensive program of discussion forums and lectures provides deeper insights into the Slow Food movement and sustainable food production. The fair is held at the easily accessible Stuttgart Exhibition Center, located near the A8 motorway. Thanks to its proximity to Stuttgart Airport and the numerous parking options available both at the exhibition grounds and in the airport parking garage, arrival by car and on foot is convenient. The connection to public transport also ensures a hassle-free arrival for visitors from different regions. With its spring timing, the "Market of Good Taste" has established itself as an important event that embodies the values of the Slow Food movement and provides a platform for exchange and discovery of regional, sustainable food and products.

InterFood Krasnodar is a specialized annual trade fair dedicated to food, beverages, and packaging technology. It has established itself as a key industry platform in southern Russia. Organized by MVK – International Exhibition Company, one of the country's leading trade fair organizers with extensive experience in hosting international exhibitions and conferences, InterFood provides industry professionals with an opportunity to explore the latest developments in the food and beverage sectors and connect with experts, manufacturers, suppliers, and decision-makers. The event takes place at Expograd Yug in Krasnodar, a modern exhibition and congress center known for its innovative infrastructure. The venue offers ideal conditions for showcasing new products, technologies, and services, making it one of the most important locations for trade events in southern Russia—further underscoring the fair’s significance. Access to InterFood is restricted to trade professionals only. This focused approach encourages practical, in-depth exchanges between exhibitors and buyers. A standout feature is the integrated negotiation center, where manufacturers and suppliers present their products directly to senior buyers and category managers from major retail chains and distributors—a unique format that enables efficient, high-level networking. The exhibition covers a broad yet clearly defined range of topics, including meat and poultry products, dairy and cheese, staple foods, grain-based goods, baked and confectionery items, non-alcoholic and low-alcohol beverages, beer, snacks, and catering supplies. This is complemented by displays of cutting-edge production and processing technologies, innovative packaging solutions, and efficient storage and logistics systems—particularly attractive to technology-focused professionals. Another highlight of the fair is its hands-on program of expert lectures and seminars on current topics such as the use of artificial intelligence in food production, brand strategies in consumer goods, lab data analysis, and risk management in manufacturing. Running alongside InterFood is the "Vinorus.Vinotech" exhibition, where Russian wineries showcase their products through professional tastings—adding further value for visitors with an interest in wine and spirits. With its thematic depth, clear focus, and recurring annual format, InterFood Krasnodar is an essential platform for professionals looking to stay ahead of industry trends, discover innovative products, and build valuable business connections—at one of Russia’s most dynamic hubs for the food and beverage industry.

The Bakery Showcase is a trade fair and conference for the bakery and confectionery industry in Canada. It takes place annually and alternates between the two Canadian cities of Montreal and Toronto. Founded in 1965, the Bakery Showcase has since developed into a major industry event. It is organised by the Baking Association of Canada (BAC), a national body representing the interests of the bakery and confectionery sector. The BAC’s membership spans the entire industry, including bakeries, suppliers, wholesalers, retailers, educational institutions and other organisations. The association places strong emphasis on keeping its members informed about the latest trends and technologies, while also providing opportunities for networking and professional development. The exhibition features a comprehensive range of products and services, including raw materials, baking equipment, packaging, services and technologies. Exhibits cover ingredients such as flour, sugar, yeast, fats, chocolate, fruit and nuts, as well as a variety of flavourings and fillings. The event also showcases ovens, dough mixers, portioning equipment, refrigeration and freezing systems, and bread and cake slicing machines. In addition, it presents a wide array of packaging solutions for bread, cakes, pastries and other baked goods, including environmentally friendly and sustainable options. Further offerings include solutions for decoration and presentation, cleaning and sanitation, and food safety in the bakery and confectionery sector, as well as bakery design and planning services, and marketing and sales support. The event focuses on innovation, sustainability and quality. Highlights include live product demonstrations, expert-led presentations and hands-on workshops. The Bakery Showcase provides trade visitors with an excellent opportunity to keep abreast of the latest industry developments while building valuable professional connections.

SALÓN GOURMETS is Europe’s leading trade fair for high-quality food and beverages, making it an essential industry event for professionals in fine foods, gastronomy, hospitality, and retail. Since its inception in 1987, it has become a central platform for exclusive delicacies, innovative products, and emerging culinary trends. Held annually at the IFEMA exhibition center in Madrid, the event benefits from modern infrastructure, excellent transport connections, and ample parking, providing ideal conditions for an international gathering of this scale. Organized by Grupo Gourmets, a renowned company dedicated to promoting fine gastronomy and premium food products for decades, SALÓN GOURMETS brings together producers, suppliers, buyers, and decision-makers from around the world. The fair fosters new business relationships and showcases the latest innovations in the industry. The extensive offering includes gourmet foods, wines, spirits, organic products, and exclusive delicacies. In addition to the traditional exhibition, the event features an extensive supporting program with tastings, live cooking demonstrations, competitions, and expert lectures that provide valuable insights into current market trends and developments. Key highlights include themed experience areas such as the Wine Tunnel, olive oil and cheese exhibitions, and the innovation space, where groundbreaking products are unveiled. A dedicated business center and a tailored matchmaking service facilitate targeted networking between exhibitors and international buyers, helping businesses expand into new markets. With its unique combination of exquisite products, high-profile industry professionals, and a world-class venue, SALÓN GOURMETS stands among the most important platforms in the fine food sector—an unmissable event for those looking to experience and market premium food and beverages at the highest level.

SIAL Canada is one of Canada’s leading trade shows for the food, beverage, and hospitality sectors, serving as a central meeting point for professionals across this dynamic industry. The name SIAL – Salon International de l’Alimentation – highlights the event’s international focus and its specialization in food-related innovation. Since its inception in 2001, the trade show has become a major driver of innovation, commerce, and exchange within the North American agri-food sector. Held alternately in Montreal and Toronto each year, SIAL Canada brings together all key players under one roof. It is organized by the renowned Comexposium Group, one of the world’s largest trade show organizers with an extensive portfolio of international events. The Canadian edition is part of a global network that includes flagship shows in Paris, Jakarta, and Abu Dhabi. A defining feature of SIAL Canada is its clear thematic structure, divided into three focus areas: SIAL Food, SIAL Grocerant, and SIAL Packaging. SIAL Food covers the entire food production spectrum – from fresh products and beverages to niche categories such as baby food, frozen goods, and functional ingredients. SIAL Grocerant explores the growing intersection between foodservice and retail, emphasizing cutting-edge kitchen equipment, payment technologies, and service solutions. SIAL Packaging focuses on innovative and sustainable packaging concepts, logistics, and technological advancements across the supply chain. In addition to a broad product offering – ranging from cheese and olive oil to high-tech packaging – the trade show provides space for knowledge exchange, industry dialogue, and inspiration. It serves as a platform for Canadian producers, international brands, start-ups, retailers, foodservice professionals, and importers to identify trends, build business relationships, and strengthen their market presence. Deeply rooted in the Canadian market, SIAL Canada reflects the country’s cultural diversity, spirit of innovation, and commitment to sustainability. At the same time, it offers international companies a gateway to enter the North American market. One of SIAL Canada’s standout features is its range of competitions that spotlight the industry’s innovative spirit. The SIAL Innovation Award honors forward-thinking product ideas, the Olive d'Or recognizes the world’s finest olive oils, and the International Cheese Competition showcases the best in global cheesemaking. Additional highlights include a pitch contest for start-ups and the “SIAL To Go” format, which offers practical insights into current market developments. The event attracts a wide professional audience – from manufacturers and distributors to institutional foodservice experts – creating a highly specialized network designed for business success. Alongside the extensive exhibition, a conference program provides in-depth analysis and discussion of key industry topics. Whether at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal or the Enercare Centre in Toronto, both venues offer modern infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and are situated in vibrant urban environments. With international airports, convenient public transit links, and thriving culinary scenes, they provide the ideal setting for a trade fair that is more than just an exhibition: SIAL Canada is an experience, a marketplace of ideas, and a bridge between local markets and global opportunities.
