The CIBUS International Food Exhibition is an annual trade fair dedicated to the diverse world of food. It is held at the Fiere di Parma exhibition center in Parma, a prominent center of Italian food culture. The name CIBUS, derived from the Latin word for "food", emphasizes the fair's central importance to the food sector. The organizer of the fair is Fiera di Parma S.p.A. It provides a platform for professionals from various sectors including wholesale, Ho.Re.Ca. sector, importers, and independent retail. The fair promotes exchange between national and international representatives from the agricultural and food sectors. The exhibition areas include dairy products, cold cuts, food and confectionery, chilled and frozen products, beverages, and specialties from local, regional, and international cuisine. CIBUS showcases a wide range of products and services, including coffee, tea, cocoa, canned goods, fresh and dried fruits and vegetables, snacks, oils, vinegars, pasta, rice, ethnic products, cereals, ready meals, baked goods, frozen products, sauces, reflecting Italy's culinary diversity and innovation. Thanks to its accessibility by both public transport and car, the fair offers a unique opportunity to discover the latest trends and products in the food sector, establish business contacts, and enjoy the extraordinary atmosphere and culture of Parma.

The "Food Bangladesh International Expo" is an annual international fair that specializes in food, beverages, and related equipment. This event provides a high-quality platform for professionals in the food industry to exchange knowledge and explore business opportunities. The fair is organized by CEMS Conference & Exhibition Management Services Ltd. and takes place at the International Convention City Bashundhara (ICCB) in Dhaka, one of the city's largest conference and exhibition centers, known for its excellent accessibility and optimal infrastructure. The main themes of the expo include a wide range of products and services from the food industry, including halal foods, beverages, juice processing equipment, chilled and frozen foods, ingredients, flavors, and food technologies. Services from related areas such as agricultural machinery, hotel and restaurant services, as well as retail and franchising are also showcased. The expo is notably rooted in the local context. A highlight of the fair includes conferences and seminars where leading experts share their expertise. At SIAL China, food manufacturers, traders, importers, wholesalers, and retailers, as well as representatives of institutional and commercial gastronomy, present and discover the latest products and services. Vitafoods Europe is the leading international trade fair for the nutraceutical industry and has been held annually since its inception in 1997. The name "Vitafoods" is derived from the words "vitality" and "food" reflecting the event’s core mission: to promote health and well-being through functional foods, dietary supplements, and innovative ingredients. The event is organized by Informa Markets, a division of Informa PLC, a global provider of trade shows and knowledge platforms. The fair is distinguished by its holistic focus on the entire value chain of the industry—from the development of bioactive raw materials and manufacturing to packaging, regulatory considerations, and market-ready products. Industry professionals gain insights into current trends, access to in-depth expertise, and opportunities to connect with a global network spanning science, industry, and commerce. Each year, Vitafoods Europe highlights trending topics such as personalized nutrition, cognitive health, and sustainable product solutions. Additional themes like women's health, the gut microbiome, sports nutrition, and functional pet food are showcased in practical formats including expert panels, live demonstrations, and tastings. Notable highlights include the Nutraceuticals Showcase Theatre featuring interactive presentations, and the Startup Challenge , which provides a platform for innovative new ventures. The Innovation Awards recognize outstanding achievements and help drive momentum within the industry. The event attracts professionals from across the health, food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics sectors—from raw material suppliers and product developers to brand owners and retailers. As part of the global Vitafoods event series, which includes editions in India and Asia, Vitafoods Europe plays a pivotal role in the international exchange of health innovation. Combining knowledge sharing, innovation promotion, and international networking, Vitafoods Europe is an essential event for anyone looking to shape the future of health.

InterFood Azerbaijan is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a key platform for the food and beverage industry in the South Caucasus. Serving as an industry meeting point, innovation forum, and international marketplace, it brings together manufacturers, distributors, technology providers, and decision-makers to showcase the latest trends, products, and solutions in the sector. The name “InterFood” symbolizes the international scope of the event and its comprehensive coverage of the entire value chain—from raw material sourcing and advanced processing technologies to packaging and marketing. The venue for the event is the modern Baku Expo Exhibition and Convention Center, located in the Azerbaijani capital of Baku. The exhibition center is distinguished by its high-quality infrastructure, convenient transport connections, and proximity to Heydar Aliyev International Airport. A particular highlight of the fair is the annual “Gızıl Şah” National Culinary Championship , an international cooking competition featuring over 200 participants from around the globe. Entries are judged by a distinguished panel of experts. The event is further enriched by targeted B2B meetings, practical workshops, and professional seminars where industry specialists discuss technological advancements, market trends, and sector-specific challenges. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors—from agricultural production and food processing to packaging and logistics services. The extensive range of offerings includes ingredients such as cereals, dairy products, chocolate, and meat, as well as functional ingredients, sauces, and spices. The exhibition also impresses with a variety of equipment—from production machinery, molds, and utensils to cooling systems, ovens, and smart devices, to testing and laboratory equipment. Additionally, packaging solutions, tableware, and ready-to-eat foods and snacks are showcased, covering everything from light meal options to coffee and tea. Bakery China is more than just a fair; it is a cultural meeting point deeply embedded in the Chinese bakery and confectionery industry, actively promoting both local and international business relations. The "Food and Beverage (FAB) West Africa" is a leading trade fair for food and beverages in West Africa, held annually at the Landmark Centre in Lagos. It not only offers a wide range of products and services from sectors such as FMCG, confectionery, beverages, kitchen and retail equipment, ingredients, machinery, packaging, dairy, rice, legumes, cereals, and frozen food, but also serves as a platform for interaction between international and local companies and a professional audience, including importers, distributors, retailers, and representatives from the hospitality industry. The organizer, BtoB Events Ltd., aims to bridge the gap between international brands and the local market. This makes the fair a key player in strengthening the regional food and beverage industry. Due to its location in Lagos, a major economic hub of West Africa, the fair has a strong local relevance and contributes to the economic development of the city and the country. The visitors mainly include traders, distribution partners, providers of commercial kitchen and food services, and gastronomes. The fair is distinguished by a variety of highlights, including the introduction of new products and trends, competitions, and the awarding of prizes that emphasize the innovation and quality of the exhibited products. The Landmark Centre, as the venue, offers excellent infrastructure and is easily accessible, making it an ideal location for this significant event. Overall, FAB West Africa provides a unique opportunity to gain insights into the food and beverage industry in West Africa and to establish important business relationships.

Bakery Tech Poland is a highly specialized trade fair focused on forward-looking technologies in the bakery and confectionery industry. It is exclusively aimed at trade professionals from the artisan sector, industrial production, and supply chain who want to experience and shape technological advancements firsthand. The fair takes place annually at the modern Ptak Warsaw Expo grounds in Nadarzyn near Warsaw – the largest exhibition center in Poland. As a central platform for industry dialogue, Bakery Tech Poland showcases current developments in automation, digitalization, sustainability, and product innovation. Developers, manufacturers, industry experts, and decision-makers present and discuss cutting-edge technologies such as robotics solutions, AI-driven production systems, IIoT-based controls, energy-efficient tunnel ovens, and automated dough processing systems. A particular focus is placed on customized baked goods and creative confectionery trends, where innovations like 3D printing, edible gold, and modern airbrush techniques open up new design possibilities. Functional products are also gaining importance — including gluten-free, vegan, high-protein, and reduced-sugar baked goods that respond to evolving consumer dietary habits. With its rich baking heritage and a growing market for industrial food technologies, Poland offers ideal conditions for a trade fair of this scale. Bakery Tech Poland not only provides a comprehensive overview of technological innovations but also reinforces Warsaw’s position as a key European hub for food processing and technology. One of the major highlights of the fair is the live demonstrations and technical showcases, where outstanding innovations are recognized and awarded. Exhibiting companies represent sectors such as machinery and plant engineering, food technology, packaging, software development, and raw material supply. Visitors primarily include artisan bakeries, industrial producers, wholesalers, product developers, and technologists. The Ptak Warsaw Expo venue impresses with its convenient location — close to major highways, Warsaw Chopin Airport, and offering ample parking space. Whether by car, shuttle service, or public transport, the venue is easily and efficiently accessible. With over 143,000 m² of exhibition space, the center is perfectly equipped to welcome international trade professionals.

The Kazakhstan International Bakery Show is the only specialized trade fair in Central Asia dedicated entirely to the bakery and confectionery industry. It serves as an indispensable platform for professionals, companies, and investors who wish to stay informed about current developments and emerging trends. KIBS offers comprehensive insights into the latest international developments as well as the specific dynamics of the Kazakh market. It contributes to the modernization of the sector and fosters international networking between producers, suppliers, technology providers, and service companies. The fair covers all key aspects of the bakery industry, ranging from production technologies, raw materials, and ingredients to automation, franchising, and packaging solutions. The exhibition is further enriched by presentations on food additives, accessories, bakery and confectionery tools, commercial equipment, and industry-related services. The range of exhibits includes fully automated production lines, dough processing machines, ovens, cooling and storage technologies, and ingredients for specialty products such as gluten-free, vegan, or sugar-free baked goods. The portfolio also features packaging design, enterprise software solutions (ERP, MES, CRM), IoT-based quality control systems, and complete business concepts for bakeries, pastry shops, and cafés. KIBS is tailored to the specific needs of the Central Asian market while also reflecting global industry trends. Exhibitors represent sectors such as mechanical engineering, food technology, raw material trade, packaging, digitalization, and retail. The audience includes bakers, pastry chefs, manufacturers, wholesalers, restaurateurs, franchisees, investors, as well as trade visitors from the HoReCa and retail sectors – a qualified professional audience with clear investment interests. The fair plays a particularly important role as a catalyst for innovation in Kazakhstan. It actively promotes the adoption of new technologies and the professionalization of the bakery and confectionery sector. Astana as the host city underscores this ambition: the young, dynamic capital offers excellent infrastructure, strong international connections, and with the IEC EXPO International Exhibition Center, provides ideal conditions for a high-profile professional event. The venue is easily accessible by car, public transport, or shuttle services, ensuring smooth access for all participants. The Kazakhstan International Bakery Show is thus an exclusive, regionally anchored trade fair held every two years in Astana – the Central Asian hotspot for innovation, networking, and business development in the bakery world.

축제소개: The “ Africa Food Show ” is one of the leading trade exhibitions for the food and beverage industry on the African continent, bringing together industry professionals, manufacturers, distributors and innovators from around the world each year. SIAL India is the country’s premier international B2B trade show for food and beverages and part of the globally renowned SIAL network ("Salon International de l’Alimentation"), known for its innovation, industry leadership, and top-tier events worldwide. The event takes place annually at the state-of-the-art Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai – India’s financial and economic hub. Organized by the French exhibition leader Comexposium, SIAL India serves as a key platform for targeted exchange between international producers, innovators, decision-makers, and buyers – within one of the fastest-growing food markets in the world. The trade fair brings together manufacturers, suppliers, and brands from all major segments of the food industry: from bakery, dairy products, confectionery, and meat and seafood, to non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, dried fruits, frozen foods, ready meals, tea and coffee, rice and grains, as well as spices, pet food, organic and health products, and cutting-edge processing and packaging technologies. It not only highlights current trends across the entire value chain but also reflects the diversity and innovative strength of the Indian market – a market of growing global relevance. A standout feature is the Hosted Buyer Program – a curated matchmaking format that connects leading buyers with suitable exhibitors, creating valuable opportunities for new business relationships. This is complemented by live cooking shows and product demonstrations, where top chefs showcase creative recipes and innovative applications in an engaging and hands-on format. SIAL India is aimed at trade visitors from retail, hospitality, food processing, wholesale, and import/export sectors. Exhibitors span a broad range of industry players – from established producers and start-ups to suppliers and technology providers. As part of the international SIAL family – with events in Paris, Shanghai, Jakarta, Montreal, and other major cities – SIAL India is firmly embedded in a global network that fosters high-level market access and international exchange. Located in the heart of Mumbai, the Jio World Convention Centre offers a modern, strategically connected venue with excellent accessibility via the international airport and city transport network. SIAL India is therefore much more than a product showcase: it is a carefully curated marketplace for forward-looking business development – locally rooted, globally connected.

The "SIGEP Asia" trade fair, held at the Sands Expo & Convention Centre in Singapore, is a branch of the esteemed SIGEP fair originally launched in Rimini, Italy. The name SIGEP stands for "Salone Internazionale Gelateria, Pasticceria e Panificazione Artigianali," which translates to "International Fair for Artisanal Ice Cream, Pastry, and Bakery." Ltd. and is one of the leading international trade fairs in the sectors of artisanal ice cream, pastry, bakery, chocolate, and coffee. The Sands Expo & Convention Centre in Singapore, with its modern infrastructure and accessibility, provides an ideal platform for exchange between exhibitors and visitors, contributing to the fair's appeal and attracting participants from all over the world.

F Istanbul – Food & Technology Exhibition is Turkey’s most comprehensive international trade fair dedicated to food, beverages, and the technologies involved in their processing and packaging. FHT Food & Hospitality Thailand is the leading international trade fair for the food and hospitality industry in the heart of Southeast Asia. Anyone interested in future trends, new business opportunities, and the leading players in the industry will find the perfect forum at FHT in Bangkok.

FHM – Food & Hotel Malaysia is Malaysia’s leading international trade exhibition for food, beverages, hospitality, gastronomy, bakery, confectionery, catering, and hospitality technologies. The Alimentaria in Barcelona, one of the world's largest trade fairs for food and beverages, serves as a central meeting point for leading manufacturers and suppliers in the industry. The SACHSENBACK is a trade fair held every two years in Dresden, specifically designed for the bakery and confectionery crafts. It is considered the most important event of its kind in Eastern Germany. Since its inception in October 1990, the fair has established itself as a central platform for professional exchange, information on the latest trends and technological developments, and for networking. The organization is handled by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, known for its expertise in organizing trade fairs well beyond regional boundaries. SACHSENBACK offers a wide range of topics from working and operating techniques to raw materials and commercial goods, as well as business furnishings and equipment. Additionally, there is a focus on sales promotion and services relevant to the bakery and confectionery crafts. A highlight is the Backforum, dedicated to the preparation of fruits, canapés, and other delicacies, as well as the presentation of showcase pastries. Moreover, topics such as snacks and the take-away market are gaining importance, underscoring the fair's relevance for current market trends. The diverse supporting program of SACHSENBACK includes hands-on demonstrations, the confectioners' idea market, and competitions, offering a wealth of opportunities for further education and inspiration. This attracts professional visitors from the entire spectrum of the industry, including independent businesses from the traditional bakery craft, confectioneries, and representatives of the bread and bakery products industry. The venue is Messe Dresden, which, with its modern infrastructure and flexible space concepts, provides ideal conditions for a trade fair of this size. Its central location and good accessibility by public transport and car make it an attractive meeting point for exhibitors and visitors from all over Germany and beyond. In summary, SACHSENBACK is more than just a fair; it serves as an industry platform that promotes the exchange of ideas and knowledge and provides a stage for innovations and technological advancements. Its triennial cycle gives each event a special character, eagerly anticipated by the participants.

TUTTOFOOD , the international trade fair, is a key platform for innovation, quality, and diversity in the food and beverage industry. Since its debut in 2007, it has become a major meeting point for the global food sector and takes place every two years at the Fiera Milano exhibition center in Rho, near Milan. The name “TUTTOFOOD” combines the Italian word Tutto (everything) with the English Food, aptly reflecting the fair’s comprehensive scope. The event is organized by Fiera Milano S.p.A., one of Europe’s leading trade fair organizers. TUTTOFOOD is exclusively aimed at professionals from across the food industry, bringing together producers, distributors, buyers, restaurateurs, importers, and decision-makers from over 140 countries. The focus lies on current industry topics such as sustainability, food trends, technological innovation, and developments throughout the entire value chain. TUTTOFOOD is distinguished not only by the wide range of products on display – from fresh and frozen foods, delicacies, pasta, confectionery, dairy and meat products to beverages, functional foods, and plant-based alternatives – but also by the high quality of its exhibitors and its strong emphasis on fostering international exchange. Dedicated areas such as the Startup Area, the TUTTOFOOD Academy featuring top chefs from APCI, and the Bellavita Expo, which celebrates Italian culinary culture, further enrich the trade fair experience. Another highlight is the TUTTOFOOD Street Experience, which takes visitors on a multisensory journey of taste. The Mixology Experience has also established itself as Italy’s largest platform for the beverage and hospitality sectors. In forums such as the Better Future Arena and the Cibus Link Arena, pressing issues related to food, supply chains, and consumer behavior are discussed in a practical, solution-oriented, and forward-thinking manner. TUTTOFOOD exemplifies Italy’s culinary excellence – from traditional craftsmanship to cutting-edge food-tech innovations. The venue, Fiera Milano, is among the most modern exhibition centers in Europe. Its excellent transport connections via highways, public transit, and Milan-Malpensa International Airport make it an ideal location for an event of this scale. TUTTOFOOD is more than just a trade fair – it is the international meeting point for all those who want to help shape the future of food.

SNACKEX, initiated in 1985, is the only international trade fair exclusively focused on savory snacks and snack nuts. Organized by the European Snacks Association (ESA), the fair takes place every two years in the summer, hosted in a different major European city each time. This format promotes the cultural diversity of Europe and brings together professionals from the snack industry to discuss current trends and innovations. The fair serves as a central meeting point for the industry, providing insights into the entire manufacturing process of savory snacks – from ingredient selection to laboratory testing, packaging processes, and the final products. SNACKEX showcases a wide range of products, including potato chips, tortilla chips, corn and pellet snacks, as well as a selection of snack nuts such as peanuts and exotic nut mixes. A distinctive feature of SNACKEX is the numerous networking opportunities with industry leaders, qualified buyers, and decision-makers. The fair acts as a platform for trade and exchange, fostering direct contact with industry leaders and supporting the formation of valuable business relationships. The event program includes social events and a conference that provides insights into future industry challenges and opportunities. Each venue contributes its local charm to the unique atmosphere of the fair, highlighting the international character of the event and inspiring both visitors and exhibitors. Thus, SNACKEX is more than just a trade fair – it is a vibrant, culturally enriching industry event that brings the entire snack industry together and creates an unparalleled platform for professional exchange and economic momentum.

The International Baking Industry Exposition (IBIE) is the largest and most influential trade show for grain-based food products in the Western Hemisphere. It serves as the central meeting point for the global baking industry—and is far more than just a traditional trade event. Every three years, the international baking community gathers at the Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC) to help shape the future of baking. Covering an exhibition area of approximately 40,000 square meters, IBIE provides a major platform for innovation, education, and economic advancement. The event is organized by the leading industry associations: the American Bakers Association (ABA) , BEMA, and the Retail Bakers of America (RBA). This alliance brings together the full spectrum of industrial and artisan baking, with the shared goal of consolidating expertise, strengthening networks, and unlocking new growth opportunities. IBIE addresses all key segments of the modern baking sector—from production and packaging technology to innovative ingredients, hygiene solutions, digitally controlled processes, and logistics applications. The technologies and trends showcased at the expo offer practical solutions that enhance operational efficiency and competitiveness. A central focus of the event is the IBIEducate program, which is dedicated to the industry’s current challenges and future priorities. In targeted learning formats, leading experts share actionable insights on topics such as process optimization, product quality, marketing strategies, and sustainable production. The show also serves as a stage for prestigious competitions. The Americas Selection of the Coupe du Monde de la Boulangerie brings together top bakery teams from across the region to compete in a range of disciplines. The World Bread Awards USA honor outstanding bread creations across numerous categories. Artistic cake design is also celebrated in a dedicated competition featuring wedding cakes, fondant work, sculpted cakes, and buttercream artistry. Exhibitors represent fields including mechanical engineering, ingredient manufacturing, packaging development, logistics, and process technology. Attendees come primarily from industrial and artisan bakeries, as well as from retail, foodservice, hospitality, product development, and grocery sectors. With its strong international connectivity, modern convention facilities, and vibrant atmosphere, Las Vegas offers the perfect setting for this global industry event. Located near Harry Reid International Airport and surrounded by a wide range of accommodations, IBIE is more than a trade show—it’s an immersive experience for all who are shaping the future of baking.

At World Trade Center Bangalore the UpperCrust Food & Wine Show is held every year, an event offering a wide range of food and beverages including bar and kitchen equipment. The products will be presented to the visitors by about 100 exhibitors in an appealing way. For all gourmets and amateur chefs, but also for international trade visitors from the gastronomy, a visit to the fair has become an absolute must and a feast for the senses. In the daily cookery demonstrations and tastings chefs and restaurant owners can get valuable suggestions. The event is a guarantee of success for the launch of new products and brands in accordance with the new, modern lifestyle of India.

The " FIRA DE REIS " in Igualada, established in 1373, is one of the oldest and most unique fairs in Catalonia. Its name, which translates to "King's Fair", highlights its traditional significance. Held annually on Epiphany, it becomes a special event. The historic Passeig Verdaguer, serving as the venue, is centrally located and contributes to the festive atmosphere. Organized by the city of Igualada, the fair attracts about 200 exhibitors each year. Across an area of 1,500 meters, they offer a wide range of products and services, including agricultural seedlings, handicrafts, regional foods, wines and spirits, clothing, artworks, decorative items, and garden supplies. This diversity emphasizes the cultural and economic importance of the region. The fair serves not only as a trading platform but also as a social event that strengthens the community and honors Catalonia's cultural heritage. It is particularly noteworthy that the FIRA DE REIS provides a platform for local farmers and craftsmen to present their products and skills to a broad audience. This attracts a diverse range of visitors, from professionals to families, who appreciate the extensive offerings. The significance of the fair extends well beyond the borders of Igualada, drawing visitors from all over Catalonia and beyond. Thus, the FIRA DE REIS is not just a showcase for local products and crafts but also a significant cultural event that honors the history and tradition of the region. The centrally located Passeig Verdaguer not only offers a picturesque setting but is also well-connected, making the fair attractive to a wide audience.

The Nepal Food & Beverages Expo, organized by Futurex Trade Fair & Events Pvt. Ltd., is a professional trade show held at the Bhrikuti Mandap Exhibition Hall in Kathmandu, a prominent center for expos in Nepal. This event targets a professional audience, including retailers, wholesalers, importers, and many other key players in the food and beverage sector. The Expo covers a wide range of topics, featuring food additives, an assortment of beverages – including beer, craft beer, cider, and non-alcoholic options – preserved and processed foods, chilled and frozen foods, chocolate, cocoa, and confectionery, concentrates, cocktails and mixes, spices and sauces, confectionery, snacks and sweets, ready meals and staples, dairy and egg products, fresh fruits and vegetables, meat, poultry and seafood, organic foods, ingredients and premixes, instant coffee and tea, juices and other beverages, as well as superfoods and vegetarian foods. The Expo is known for its extensive diversity of products and services, offering participants a chance to discover the latest trends and innovations in the food and beverage industry. It also serves as a showcase for new and emerging brands looking to present their products to an international audience. A key feature of the Nepal Food & Beverages Expo is the opportunity for direct business networking and staying informed about the latest market developments. The event also provides a forum for discussions and workshops, offering valuable insights into the industry. In summary, the Nepal Food & Beverages Expo is a vital meeting point for professionals in the food and beverage industry, offering a comprehensive overview of the latest products, services, and trends. It plays a crucial role in promoting trade and partnerships within this dynamic sector.

Egy Sweet is the leading platform for innovation in Egypt's confectionery and snack industry, held annually at the Cairo International Conference Center (CICC) in Nasr City, Cairo. This indispensable event serves as a central meeting point for industry professionals to discover the latest machinery, raw materials, and technologies required for the production of confectioneries and snacks. Hosted by the Trust International Group, the fair offers a unique combination of exchange and innovation. It addresses key topics such as technology, innovation, raw materials, ingredients, sustainable packaging solutions, safety standards, and food safety, which are crucial for enhancing efficiency and quality in production and for promoting food safety. At Egy Sweet, manufacturers and dealers present their products and services, ranging from raw materials and production requirements to packaging and cooling technologies. The fair serves not only as a platform for business exchange but also as a venue for introducing new products and innovations. Moreover, the fair contributes to the economic vitality of Cairo and positions Egypt as a significant hub in the global confectionery industry. The modernly equipped Cairo International Conference Center, located in Nasr City, one of Cairo's major business districts, provides the ideal backdrop for this significant industrial event. Egy Sweet, accessible to both local and international visitors, is thus an essential part of Egypt's industrial landscape and an annual highlight for industry experts worldwide.

Bakery Plus is more than just a trade fair – it serves as a central platform for those who are passionate and knowledgeable about shaping the future of bakery, confectionery, and sweet goods technology. The name "Bakery Plus" symbolizes the diversity of the event’s offerings: beyond traditional baking topics, it covers areas such as ice cream production, advanced packaging technologies, and formats for professional exchange and continuing education – all delivering real added value to the industry. Twice a year – in spring and autumn – the ATO Congresium International Convention & Exhibition Centre in Ankara becomes the meeting point for professionals and decision-makers from across the globe. The event is organized by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, which brings many years of experience and strong industry expertise to ensure a professionally executed and content-rich exhibition. At the heart of the event are state-of-the-art technologies and machinery for bakeries, confectioneries, and ice cream production, as well as systems for processing chocolate and sweets. The range is further enhanced by dough processing equipment, kitchen solutions for hotels, cafés, and bars, refrigeration technology, frozen products, additives, decorative items, and concepts for store design and shop fittings. Bakery Plus targets a highly specialized professional audience – including bakers, pastry chefs, chocolatiers, frozen food manufacturers, food engineers, investors, and decision-makers from the hospitality and foodservice sectors. Representatives from trade associations, educational institutions, and the media also attend to stay informed, build networks, and explore new product ideas. A standout feature of the event is its practical programming, including live demonstrations, competitions between young talents and master bakers, and a varied schedule of seminars and workshops. This combination of exhibition and knowledge transfer has firmly established Bakery Plus as a key date in the industry’s event calendar. The venue – the ATO Congresium in Ankara – impresses with its modern infrastructure, central location, and excellent accessibility via Esenboğa Airport and the city's well-developed transport network. As a dynamic hub for trade fairs and technology, Ankara offers ideal conditions for international exchange and forward-looking innovation – the perfect setting for a trade fair that is more than just an exhibition: Bakery Plus is a comprehensive experience for the entire industry.

전시회명: NRW – The Best from the Region
축제소개: Founded in 2011, the "NRW – The Best from the Region" fair is an annual regional trade show held every November, proudly showcasing the culinary diversity and artisanal crafts of North Rhine-Westphalia. Hosted by Messe Essen GmbH, this event attracts countless visitors each year who are interested in regional products and local food culture. It has become a fixed event on the trade fair calendar, taking place in the modern facilities of Messe Essen, which are easily accessible and offer extensive services. "NRW – The Best from the Region" stands out for its special focus on regional products. In an atmosphere that is appealing to both consumers and professional visitors, the exhibition provides a platform for producers and craftsmen to present their goods and services. Visitors have the opportunity to discover and sample a wide range of products, from traditional foods to handmade items, all with an emphasis on quality and sustainability. A distinctive feature of the fair is its transparency regarding the manufacturing processes of the products. Exhibitors are encouraged to share information about cultivation, production, and animal husbandry, transforming the fair into an educational platform for responsible consumption. This informative aspect is enhanced by a supporting program that includes brief presentations on selected topics. Here, current and relevant industry issues are discussed, making the fair an important hub for the exchange of ideas and further education in the region. Entertainment is also provided: the fair regularly features competitions, and as a special highlight, visitors can experience cooking demonstrations by a famous Michelin-starred chef. These events are not only entertaining but also allow for an interactive engagement with regional cuisine. "NRW – The Best from the Region" takes place under the umbrella of MHH (MODE HEIM HANDWERK), enabling synergies with related industries. With its unique combination of information, education, and entertainment, this event has established itself as an indispensable occasion that celebrates regional identity while simultaneously promoting important discussions about food production and consumption.

The SIAL InterFOOD is a leading international trade fair for the food and beverage industry, held annually at the JIExpo Jakarta International Expo in Indonesia. The name "SIAL" stands for "Salon International de l'Alimentation", which translates to "International Food Salon", emphasizing the global significance of this event. It is organized by the SIAL Group in collaboration with Krista Exhibitions and is part of a global series of SIAL trade fairs. At this fair, manufacturers, traders, and professionals from the gastronomy and retail sectors gather to showcase the latest products and innovations. Key themes include food and beverages, technologies, bakery and confectionery products, and catering equipment and ingredients. Special attention is given to sectors such as wine and spirits, coffee, tea, cocoa, as well as organic and Halal-certified products. Another focus is on services and technologies for hotels, catering, restaurants, and supermarkets, which directly relate to Jakarta's dynamic hospitality scene and Indonesia's growing market infrastructure. Competitions such as cooking contests, pastry championships, and live cooking demonstrations highlight the creative and innovative atmosphere of the fair. Each year, SIAL InterFOOD attracts thousands of professional visitors from around the world, including many decision-makers from food production, retail, and gastronomy. It serves not only as a platform for business deals but also as a venue for exchanging ideas on the latest trends and developments in food technology and production. The JIExpo, as the venue, offers ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors with its modern infrastructure and excellent accessibility via the international airport and superb transport connections. As part of the vibrant metropolis of Jakarta, the fair provides an excellent opportunity to expand networks and explore new business opportunities. Overall, SIAL InterFOOD is an indispensable event, distinguished by its thematic diversity as well as the quality and variety of the products and services presented.

The CHOCAF Fair, launched in 2015, is an outstanding event dedicated entirely to the themes of chocolate and coffee. It takes place annually at the Centre de conventions d’Oran in Oran and is organized by Vision Future. The name "CHOCAF" is derived from the words "chocolate" and "coffee", reflecting the fair's central themes. CHOCAF, the first fair of its kind in Algeria, provides a comprehensive insight into the world of chocolate and coffee. It brings together a multitude of exhibitors from various sectors, including manufacturers of chocolate, coffee, pastries, cookies, confectionery, ice cream, as well as providers of equipment, packaging, industrial hygiene, raw materials, and educational offerings. The fair serves as a platform for producers and craftsmen to present their products and services to a wide audience of professionals and enthusiasts of these delicacies. In Algeria, the fair holds a significant position and attracts great media interest. It promotes exchange between amateurs and professionals and offers space for communication and sharing of experiences through demonstrations, experiments, tastings, and sales exhibitions. One of the highlights of the fair are the prestigious competitions in various categories, such as artistic chocolate creations and chocolate desserts, judged by international juries and renowned confectioners. These competitions contribute not only to the national but also to the international reputation of chocolate and coffee. Visitors to the fair come from different sectors, primarily from the areas of food production and processing. The fair offers an ideal opportunity to discover new products, forge business relationships, and stay informed about the latest trends and developments in the industry.

The Cake Fiesta Manila, abbreviated as CFM, has established itself as the first and largest international fair for baking and cake decorating in the Philippines. Traditionally held in Pasay City, it attracts professionals, enthusiasts, and amateur bakers from all over the world. As a hub of cake artistry, Cake Fiesta Manila provides a platform for the exchange of expert knowledge, creative ideas, and the latest trends in the baking industry. Participants have the unique opportunity to learn from world-renowned artists who share their expertise in cake decorating through hands-on workshops and live demonstrations. These interactive sessions enable visitors to learn new techniques and enhance their skills. The fair impresses not only with its educational offerings but also with the variety of cakes on display. With nearly 200 artfully designed creations, it offers a true feast for the senses and holds the record for the most cakes displayed in the Philippines. Another highlight of Cake Fiesta Manila is the exciting live cake decorating competition. Participants of various skill levels compete in different categories to showcase their talents and vie for prizes and recognition. In summary, Cake Fiesta Manila is a must-visit for anyone involved in the world of baking and cake decorating. With its diverse range of workshops, live demonstrations, competitions, and networking opportunities, it provides a unique chance to get inspired, learn, and become part of a vibrant community that shares a passion for baking.

The " Premium Food Show " is an annual trade fair held at Tokyo Big Sight, Japan's largest exhibition and convention center in Tokyo. It is organized by the Premium Food Show Executive Committee in collaboration with the First Co., Ltd. Global Business Promotion Division, attracting experts from the global food industry. The fair focuses on showcasing Halal products, vegan and plant-based foods, gluten-free, and organic foods, thus reflecting the latest trends and developments in these rapidly growing segments. This product range not only addresses the growing global demands for healthy and ethical nutrition but also considers specific dietary needs and preferences. The Premium Food Show is distinguished by a series of seminars and conferences that impart the latest expertise and highlight current topics in the food industry. Numerous industry representatives, including producers, traders, and buyers of specialty foods, as well as restaurateurs and hoteliers, use the fair to explore new business opportunities. The event strongly reflects its connection with the host city Tokyo, known for its culinary diversity and innovation. The venue, Tokyo Big Sight, offers excellent infrastructure and is easily accessible both by public transport and by car. In summary, the Premium Food Show is a central meeting point for professionals looking to exchange information on the latest developments, products, and services in the food industry. It provides a platform to discover innovative solutions that will significantly influence both the market and the lifestyle of consumers.

개최장소(베뉴): WTCMM World Trade Center Metro Manila
축제소개: The "Philippine Food Expo" (PFE) is a leading trade fair for the Philippine food and beverage industry. It serves as a central platform for producers, traders, and investors to showcase and discuss innovations, trends, and market opportunities in the agricultural and food sectors. Organized by PHILFOODEX INC., the expo takes place annually at the World Trade Center Metro Manila, bringing together key industry players. A particular focus is placed on evolving consumer habits, influenced by rising incomes, urbanization, and population growth. The expo highlights the challenges and opportunities of globalization in the food trade while emphasizing sustainable solutions. Companies present strategies to enhance productivity, optimize resource utilization, and ensure a stable market demand. The extensive range of products includes a variety of beverages such as juices, coffee, tea, milk, wine, and spirits, as well as baked goods, dairy products, chilled and frozen foods, confectionery, and fresh and processed fruits and vegetables. Additionally, seafood, herbs, organic health foods, and modern food equipment and accessories are featured. The expo portfolio is further enriched by packaging and labeling solutions, franchising, industry publications, packaging design, and distribution management. As a result, the Philippine Food Expo serves as a comprehensive platform for manufacturers, distributors, restaurateurs, and retailers. One of the standout features of the expo is its interactive special events, distinguishing it from other industry fairs. These include culinary competitions for students and faculty in hospitality management and culinary arts, featuring disciplines such as food styling and photography, healthy pasta, and Philippine regional table setting. The program is complemented by professional and business seminars offering valuable insights into current market strategies and industry developments. An investment forum provides new business perspectives, while targeted media exposure ensures broad public awareness. The Philippine Food Expo is not only a showcase for Philippine products but also highlights Manila's role as a hub for the food industry in Southeast Asia. It brings together professionals from production, distribution, gastronomy, retail, and technology, all seeking new business opportunities, partnerships, and innovative solutions. As a national flagship event, it sets industry benchmarks and contributes to the advancement of the country’s agricultural and food sectors. The venue, the World Trade Center Metro Manila, is situated in an economically vibrant region with excellent infrastructure. The expo is easily accessible from the Ninoy Aquino International Airport and Manila’s major business districts. This makes the Philippine Food Expo not only a must-attend event for industry professionals but also a gateway to one of Asia’s fastest-growing food markets.

The "CHOCOLATE & BAKERY EXPO (CBEX)," held annually at the Bombay Exhibition Centre in Mumbai, has established itself as a leading event in the chocolate and bakery industry. It is organized by RADIAANT UNIFY Ltd. This trade fair provides a unique platform for leading suppliers and brands to showcase their latest products and innovations. The expo is distinguished by its focus on six main themes: chocolate, bakery products, ingredients and raw materials, machinery and equipment, packaging solutions, and services. These areas are crucial for the development and efficiency enhancement within the industry. Moreover, the expo highlights the latest trends and technological advancements. The "CHOCOLATE & BAKERY EXPO" showcases a variety of products, including handmade chocolates, specialty breads, gluten-free bakery items, organic chocolates, professional ovens, and chocolate molding machines. It also features raw materials such as cocoa beans and butter, advanced packaging materials, and marketing and sales solutions. CBEX reflects the dynamic market changes and provides an excellent opportunity for industry professionals to network, exchange knowledge, and establish valuable contacts. Exhibitors from various sectors, such as food production, wholesale and retail, and gastronomy, present their innovations. Furthermore, the expo has a strong local relevance, as Mumbai is a significant economic and trade center in India and offers ideal conditions for international events. The modernly equipped Bombay Exhibition Centre, with its accessibility, is the perfect venue for this event. Thus, the "CHOCOLATE & BAKERY EXPO" is more than just a fair; it is a central meeting point for innovation and progress in the art of chocolate and bakery production.

Anuga Select China , formerly known as ANUFOOD China, is a leading international trade fair for food and beverages, held annually in China since its launch in 2014. The event takes place at the impressive Shenzhen Exhibition & Convention Center—one of the largest and most advanced exhibition venues in the world. It is organised by Koelnmesse Co. Ltd. Beijing, an experienced, globally active trade fair organiser based in the Chinese capital. Each year, the show attracts a wide range of trade visitors and exhibitors from across the food and beverage industry. The exhibition covers a broad spectrum of sectors, including dairy products, meat, fish, baked goods, beverages, fine foods, frozen foods and snacks. A particular focus is placed on sustainable and innovative products that cater to the evolving demands of the rapidly growing Chinese market. One of the event’s highlights is its extensive tasting programme, offering visitors the chance to explore new flavours and product innovations. The fair also features a variety of networking events designed to facilitate connections and knowledge exchange among industry professionals. In addition, ANUFOOD China hosts a range of live shows, including cooking demonstrations, product showcases and competitions, where renowned chefs and industry experts demonstrate their skills. These live presentations provide an engaging way for visitors to discover emerging trends, techniques and products, while drawing inspiration from leading professionals. Through these interactive elements, the fair offers a dynamic and varied experience, giving participants a comprehensive insight into the world of food and beverages. In recent years, ANUFOOD China has established itself as a key platform for international trade and for companies seeking to expand into the Chinese market. In summary, ANUFOOD China is a major industry event that showcases and promotes innovation and business opportunities within the global food and beverage sector.

Food & Drinks is an annual, specialized trade fair for the food and beverage industry, held each spring in the Moldovan capital, Chișinău. The name not only symbolizes the fair's culinary focus but has also established itself internationally as a hallmark of quality, innovation, and regional diversity. The event takes place at the International Exhibition Centre MoldExpo (IEC MoldExpo), the country’s largest and most modern exhibition venue. Its central location and excellent transport connections make it ideally suited for both international exhibitors and trade visitors. The event is organized by I.E.C. MOLDEXPO S.A., a seasoned company specializing in the organization of international trade fairs and conferences across various industries. The aim of "Food & Drinks" is to provide companies with a platform to showcase their products, services, and technological developments, while also promoting international exchange and fostering new business relationships. The fair centers around innovative solutions and current trends in the sectors of food, beverages, gastronomy, food technology, and packaging. Exhibits range from meat and dairy products to frozen goods and confectionery, as well as alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Both Moldovan specialties and international delicacies—particularly from Italian cuisine—are featured. The product range is complemented by modern machinery and technologies for food processing, filling and packaging systems, and software solutions that support the digital transformation of the industry. Suppliers from the hospitality and catering sectors will also find a wide selection of professional kitchen equipment, hygiene solutions, and innovations for large-scale and institutional catering. A standout feature of the fair is its diverse supporting program, which includes live cooking shows, product tastings, expert lectures, and networking events. These elements facilitate exchange between exhibitors and visitors, turning the fair into a vibrant forum for professionals. Food & Drinks attracts trade visitors from across Eastern Europe, the Balkans, and beyond—including retailers, wholesalers, restaurateurs, hoteliers, importers, technology providers, and industry journalists. For many companies, it serves as a key platform for market entry and the initiation of strategic partnerships. In summary, "Food & Drinks" in Chișinău is much more than a trade fair—it is a vital driver of Moldova’s food industry. With its international orientation, focus on quality and innovation, and the professional organization provided by MoldExpo, it makes a significant contribution to the country’s economic development. Thanks to its convenient location—just a few kilometers from the city center, well connected by public transport, and easily accessible from the airport—the fair is an attractive meeting point for trade professionals from around the world.

Expo ANTAD in Guadalajara is the premier trade fair for the retail, gastronomy, and hospitality sectors in Mexico and across Latin America. As a central platform for business meetings, innovations, and trade strategies, it brings together industry professionals from around the world each year to showcase the latest trends, cutting-edge technologies, and top-tier products. Organized by the Asociación Nacional de Tiendas de Autoservicio y Departamentales (ANTAD), the exhibition provides an exclusive opportunity to actively shape the future of retail. The event focuses on key industry segments, including food and beverages—from fresh ingredients to innovative processed products—bakery goods and modern baking techniques, as well as healthy and fresh produce that meet the growing demands for nutrition and quality of life. Additionally, the expo serves as a global trade platform where producers and retailers from around the world present their products. Another key highlight of Expo ANTAD is the presentation of new retail technologies, featuring modern solutions for logistics, last-mile services, and innovative packaging systems. The fair also showcases furniture and equipment for store design, optimizing retail spaces and enhancing the shopping experience. A standout feature of the event is the annual ANTAD Entrepreneur Challenge Contest, which recognizes and promotes promising, innovative products with high market potential. Complementing the exhibition is a comprehensive conference and lecture program, offering in-depth expert insights on strategies, market analysis, future technologies, and consumer trends in retail, gastronomy, and hospitality. Expo ANTAD takes place annually at Expo Guadalajara, one of Mexico’s most significant event venues, known for its state-of-the-art infrastructure and international atmosphere. The dynamic economic hub of Guadalajara, renowned for its thriving trade and innovation landscape, provides the ideal setting for a trade fair that shapes the retail industry and drives new momentum across the sector. This trade-only event offers businesses a unique opportunity to increase brand visibility, establish strategic partnerships, and stay informed about the latest industry developments. With its strong international focus, hands-on solutions, and first-class networking opportunities, Expo ANTAD is the must-attend event for anyone looking to actively influence the future of retail and the food industry.

The "Siag - Algeria Food Expo," an annual trade fair held in Oran, Algeria, at the Centre de Conventions d'Oran, was first organized in 2013. It is recognized as an important platform for the presentation and promotion of products, services, and innovations in the food industry sector. As a key event for the food and agricultural industry, the fair, organized by Proximity PR, attracts professionals, decision-makers, and experts from various sectors. The fair showcases a wide range of products and services. These include meat and its derivatives, bakery products, confectionery, pasta, vegetables, dairy products, canned goods, beverages, flavors, ingredients, and frozen products. Also in focus are machinery and production processes, packaging, hygiene, food safety, chemistry, energy, as well as equipment for community facilities and the construction industry. The "Siag - Algeria Food Expo" plays a significant role for the city of Oran and for Algeria as a whole, representing the largest market in the Maghreb and thus providing an ideal platform for presenting and discussing new ideas and investment opportunities in the agricultural sector. Special highlights of the fair include the SIAG Chef Zone, where renowned chefs and confectioners prepare their creations using the exhibited products, and high-quality conferences featuring world-famous speakers and leading industry experts. The exhibitors come from various sectors of the food and agricultural industry. The visitors to the fair are mainly professionals, business people, and decision-makers from these sectors. The Centre de Conventions d’Oran, as the venue for the fair, is distinguished by its modern infrastructure and the ability to host large-scale events. It provides an ideal setting for this important fair and contributes to establishing Oran as a central hub for business and trade in the region.

SIGEP China is the exclusive Asian edition of the renowned Italian trade fair SIGEP Rimini, which has been recognized since 1979 as a leading international platform for gelato, pastry, bakery, and coffee. Launched in 2023, the Chinese edition is held annually at the state-of-the-art Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center—one of Asia’s largest and most advanced exhibition venues. The event is organized by Koelnmesse (Beijing) Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of the globally active Koelnmesse Group, in collaboration with the Italian Exhibition Group China. As a purely professional trade fair, SIGEP China is tailored exclusively for industry experts, offering them a dedicated platform to discover the latest innovations, products, and technologies in the world of artisanal sweets. The Italian roots of the brand name “SIGEP”—an acronym for Salone Internazionale Gelateria, Pasticceria, Panificazione Artigianali e Caffè—remain a core element of its identity. This legacy is preserved in the Chinese edition, while the content and presentation are thoughtfully adapted to meet the specific needs and trends of the Asian market. Focusing on five main segments—gelato, bakery, pastry, chocolate, and coffee—SIGEP China covers the entire value chain of these indulgent sectors. Exhibitors showcase state-of-the-art gelato machines, premium ingredients, and inventive recipes for handcrafted ice cream. In the bakery section, attention centers on high-performance ovens, dough-processing equipment, and innovative baking ingredients. The pastry area features exquisite raw materials, delicate decorating techniques, and professional tools for fine confectionery. Chocolate artistry also takes the spotlight, with live demonstrations highlighting processing technologies, refinement techniques, and new product developments. The coffee section rounds out the experience with a wide array of elements—from barista tools and roasting methods to the latest in coffee machine technology. A standout feature of the event is its exclusive competitions, which offer not only inspiration but also valuable insight into the highest standards of global craftsmanship. The Gelato World Cup (China Selection), the Juniores Pastry World Cup (China Selection), and the CTI Coffee Art Competition bring creative excellence and international talent to the forefront, promoting professional exchange and highlighting global industry trends. With its international orientation, close ties to its storied parent fair in Rimini, and its strategic alignment with the Asian market, SIGEP China offers a unique platform for anyone looking to shape the future of artisanal sweets.

Confitexpo is an international trade fair for confectionery, snacks, and festive accessories, held every summer since 1986 at the Guadalajara Exhibition Center in the Mexican metropolis of Guadalajara. The name "Confitexpo" is derived from the Spanish words Confitería (confectionery) and Expo (exhibition), precisely reflecting the event’s focus: a comprehensive showcase of the confectionery industry in all its facets. The fair is organized by Grupo GEFECC, S.A. de C.V. , an experienced event management company specializing in industry-specific, business-oriented trade shows. It is considered one of the leading players in Mexico’s trade fair sector. Confitexpo is exclusively aimed at trade professionals and positions itself as a specialized B2B platform. It attracts participants from over 17 countries, including importers, wholesalers, manufacturers, and decision-makers with clear purchasing intent. At its core, the exhibition presents current products and services from the confectionery industry—from traditional offerings such as chocolate, candies, cookies, and gummies, to raw materials, as well as cutting-edge machinery, equipment, and packaging technologies for industrial production. Related sectors, such as party supplies, festive items, and balloon manufacturers, are also represented, highlighting their close connection to the emotionally driven world of confectionery. The trade fair is complemented by hands-on seminars that explore technological innovations and industry trends. These sessions provide tangible value for attendees and support businesses in maintaining their competitiveness in a dynamic market environment. Exhibitors range across the entire value chain—from small specialty producers to international suppliers. The event serves as a targeted business platform for establishing new commercial relationships, initiating strategic partnerships, and facilitating concrete business transactions. As Mexico’s largest exhibition venue, the Guadalajara Exhibition Center offers modern infrastructure and expansive exhibition space. It is easily accessible by taxi, rental car, or public transportation. With this, Confitexpo delivers not only in terms of content, but also in organization, meeting international standards on every level.

개최장소(베뉴): Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
축제소개: The HKTDC Food Expo is Asia’s leading trade and public exhibition for food and gastronomy. It takes place every August at the renowned Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, one of the city’s most iconic landmarks. The event is organized by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC), a key institution dedicated to promoting international trade and Hong Kong’s economic development. The expo serves as a forward-looking platform that brings together the entire spectrum of the food market under one roof. Its clearly defined sections ensure remarkable diversity. The Food Expo is reserved exclusively for industry professionals, focusing on innovation, technological advancements, and international sourcing. The Public Hall and the exclusive Gourmet Zone invite the general public to shop and discover culinary highlights. The HKTDC Food Expo showcases premium products, everyday classics, and specialties from around the globe, while also addressing current trends such as alternative proteins, 3D food printing, and intelligent packaging solutions. The range of products extends from branded delicacies, organic and wellness items, snacks, confectionery, pasta, ready meals, and beverages to halal foods, meat, seafood, dairy products, and plant-based alternatives. The thematic scope reflects Hong Kong’s global and cultural diversity: Asian and Western delicacies, vegetarian and vegan specialties, coffee, tea, craft beer, fine wines, health and nutrition products, innovative food tech solutions, as well as numerous OEM and private label offerings are all in focus. A comprehensive supporting program featuring cooking shows, live tastings, expert talks, and award ceremonies sets new standards each year and creates memorable culinary experiences. The expo is a central meeting point for decision-makers and trendsetters from retail, wholesale, import, export, gastronomy, and hospitality. Exhibitors and visitors represent every segment of the international food and beverage industry, including manufacturers, distributors, buyers, and food enthusiasts. Together with concurrent events such as the Hong Kong International Tea Fair and the HKTDC Home Delights Expo, the HKTDC Food Expo forms the centerpiece of Hong Kong’s vibrant exhibition scene. The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre impresses with its modern infrastructure and excellent public transport connections, ensuring a comfortable and efficient experience for all participants. The Food Expo is thus not only an international industry gathering, but also a significant driver of Hong Kong’s economic vitality and innovative spirit.

Indian FoodEx is an annual international trade fair that has established itself as a key platform for innovations, technologies, and products across the entire food value chain. The event is held annually in Bangalore – a city known as both an IT center and a dynamic location for trade and the food industry in India. Organized by the renowned Media Today Group , a seasoned trade fair organizer that sets new standards with its industry-specific exhibitions across India, Indian FoodEx offers a professional forum that brings together leading companies, emerging players, and key decision-makers from around the world. It fosters knowledge exchange, facilitates business partnerships, and supports targeted market development. The exhibition focuses on cutting-edge machinery and technologies for food processing and packaging, hotel and kitchen equipment, cold chain solutions, organic and functional foods, digital coding and logistics systems, automation, and post-harvest and agricultural technologies. The offering is complemented by a diverse range of fresh and processed food products – including Basmati rice, tea, spices, frozen foods, baked goods, dairy products, snacks, juices, pickles, as well as convenience and plant-based foods. Forward-looking segments such as robotic packaging systems, digital temperature control, export services, seafood processing equipment, and certified organic products are given special emphasis. Indian FoodEx stands out not only for its thematic depth but also for its clear target group orientation: it addresses professionals from food production, retail, wholesale, hospitality, research, agriculture, logistics, and export sectors, offering tailored solutions, the latest technologies, and direct access to decision-makers and investors. Exhibitors represent a broad spectrum of relevant industries – from food and machinery manufacturers to packaging experts, research institutions, certification bodies, international consulates, and agri-financing companies. The trade fair serves both as a showcase for India’s rapidly growing food industry and as a platform for international market participants looking to establish a foothold in one of the fastest-expanding markets worldwide. A varied supporting program featuring workshops, live demonstrations, and expert presentations provides practical insights and valuable impulses for the continued advancement of the sector.

International Foodtech has established itself as a leading trade fair for food processing and hospitality in Eastern and Northeastern India. Known as "International Foodtech Kolkata" (IFK), the event stands for technological innovation and represents the intersection of tradition and progress within India’s dynamic food and hospitality sectors. Held annually at the modern Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan exhibition grounds in Kolkata, the fair benefits from a strategic location and excellent transport connectivity. Organised by N.K. Kapur & Co. (P) Ltd., a seasoned Indian trade fair agency specialising in industry-specific exhibitions, IFK serves as an important driver of growth and innovation for the region’s food economy. The event is aimed at professionals from food production, hospitality, confectionery and bakery sectors, as well as the retail food trade – not only from India but also from neighbouring countries such as Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, and Myanmar. This has made IFK a vital hub for both regional and international business development. At the heart of the exhibition are forward-looking technologies for safe and efficient food processing, advanced packaging solutions, cutting-edge cold chain systems, and new developments in additives and flavouring agents. A strong emphasis is placed on the bakery and confectionery sectors, supported by expert seminars, panel discussions, and live demonstrations tailored for bakers and pastry professionals. The hospitality industry is also comprehensively covered – from professional kitchen equipment and catering solutions to culinary innovation. Exhibitors showcase the latest in processing technologies, packaging machinery, ovens, confectionery production systems, food safety solutions, ingredient innovations, and specialised services. Participants range from established brands and start-ups to machinery manufacturers, suppliers, hoteliers, and food industry experts, all aligned with emerging market trends and developments. Key highlights of the event include a dedicated conference for the confectionery and snack industries, seminars for bakery and patisserie professionals, and interactive forums on culinary topics. IFK positions itself not merely as a product showcase, but as a platform for knowledge exchange, networking, and strategic business growth. The venue, Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan, offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and easy accessibility – via Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, multiple rail connections, and a well-developed public transport network. In a city renowned for its culinary diversity, International Foodtech provides not only insight into the latest technologies but also an inspiring environment for all those shaping the future of the food industry.

개최장소(베뉴): MCEC - Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: "Fine Food Australia" represents more than just a name—it's a commitment to quality and excellence. Embracing the "Fine Food" label, the emphasis is on select foods, drinks, and services within the hospitality sector. Established in 1984, this event has become a pivotal gathering for the Australian food and hospitality sectors. It's expertly organised by Diversified Communications Australia, specialists in hosting international fairs and events. Annually in September, "Fine Food Australia" alternates between two renowned venues: the International Convention Centre (ICC) in Sydney and the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre. It showcases the latest trends, products, and innovations that drive the industry. Key features include food specialties, catering, front-of-house equipment, beverages, coffee and tea, bakery tools, hotel and retail tech, dairy insights, and pioneering packaging solutions. A significant portion of exhibitors hail from retail, food service, and hospitality backgrounds. This event allows them to showcase their newest products and services to a vast industry audience. Primarily, it attracts buyers and key decision-makers from the aforementioned sectors, presenting them with an unparalleled opportunity to keep abreast of industry innovations and establish business connections. Concluding, it's worth noting the strategic locations of both venues: the ICC in Sydney and the Convention Centre in Melbourne. Their central positioning coupled with excellent transport links ensures ease of access. The annual city switch offers attendees a unique opportunity to witness the vibrant facets of the Australian food and hospitality industry. Explore "Fine Food Australia" and delve into a realm of culinary innovation and discovery!

The " Inter Food EXPO ", held annually at the Karen Demirchyan-Komplex in Yerevan, Armenia, is an international trade fair for the food industry. Organized by the Logos Expo Center, it has established itself as an indispensable platform for industry leaders and representatives from both wholesale and retail sectors. Armenia's geographical position, increasingly important in global food production and distribution, adds significant relevance to the fair. The aim of the Inter Food EXPO is to showcase a wide range of products and services. These include meat and dairy products, non-alcoholic beverages, mineral water, spirits, tobacco products, confectioneries, and ice cream. The fair also presents the latest technologies in food production and packaging, making it an essential gathering for professionals in the field. The fair not only offers insights into innovations and new products but also serves as an educational platform. Seminars and round-table discussions on current issues and future perspectives of the food industry are held, emphasizing its role as a place for learning and professional exchange. Annually, the fair attracts a diverse array of industry representatives, including manufacturers, suppliers, wholesalers, and retailers. It is also a magnet for restaurateurs and governmental regulatory bodies, highlighting the variety of participants and the broad interest it generates. The Karen Demirchyan-Komplex, with its modern facilities and convenient access, is an ideal venue. Moreover, Yerevan's rich cultural and historical context provides additional incentives for international visitors to attend the fair and take the opportunity to explore Armenia.

개최장소(베뉴): RFECC Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center
축제소개: SaudiFood Manufacturing has established itself as a leading trade fair and central procurement hub for the food and beverage industry. This annual event, held at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center in Riyadh, attracts professionals from the global and regional food processing sectors. The event is organized by dmg::events, a seasoned organizer known for high-quality and well-attended trade shows. The fair covers topics such as food ingredients, processing, packaging, and control and automation technologies. It showcases specific products and services, including color enzymes, emulsifiers, cultures, fermentation starters, plant extracts, stabilizers, and solutions for meat processing, baking, and beverage processing. A special focus is placed on state-of-the-art cooling technologies, food safety and quality, and innovative packaging and logistics solutions. The fair plays a crucial role for Riyadh and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia by supporting local and regional businesses and enabling them to connect with international markets. This contributes to economic development and strengthens Saudi Arabia's position in the food and beverage industry. One of the highlights of the fair is the "Saudi Food Manufacturing Awards," which recognize outstanding innovations and best practices in the industry. Curated Innovation Tours and the Food Forward Summit offer participants the opportunity to learn about new trends and gain valuable insights. The main target audience of the fair includes professionals from the food processing and beverage industries, packaging technology, and related technology and service sectors. The attendees are primarily high-ranking trade buyers, corporate decision-makers, and leading industry experts. The modern and accessible Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center offers excellent infrastructure and transportation links, making it easier for participants and exhibitors to attend the fair and explore the diverse opportunities in the city of Riyadh.

The Genusswerk, officially known as the Trade Fair for Bakers, Butchers, and Restaurateurs, takes place every two years in Ulm, in the heart of Southern Germany. Since its inaugural event in 2014, it has become a central marketplace for the food craft industry in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The fair is organized by the cooperative FD-Fleischerdienst – Allgäu/Schwaben eG, in collaboration with other cooperatives. This cooperative is particularly dedicated to promoting the local butcher and gastronomy sectors. As a venue, the Ulm Exhibition Center offers a modern and easily accessible infrastructure that perfectly meets the needs of exhibitors and visitors. In the spacious halls and extensive outdoor areas, leading suppliers from all relevant specialized and supply sectors showcase their latest products and services. FAMEBA features classic assortments such as meat and sausage products, cheese, and dairy products while also serving as a platform for the latest industry trends and innovations, including state-of-the-art kitchen technology and hygiene solutions. Noteworthy segments include the snack and catering sectors, gourmet products, and regional specialties, complemented by a wide range of frozen products, canned goods, fish, delicacies, as well as beverages and spirits. Technical innovations in shopfitting, furnishing technology, and packaging and advertising services are also key focuses of the fair. Genusswerk offers a broad spectrum of services, including consulting in finance, energy, and IT, making it an essential event for professionals in the food industry. The success and significance of the fair are underscored by a high-profile list of exhibitors, including well-known brands such as Bedford, Bürger, and Victorinox. In summary, Genusswerk in Ulm is a crucial meeting point for professionals in the food craft industry, providing an excellent opportunity to learn about and exchange information on the latest products, trends, and services in an atmosphere that is both collegial and professional.
